sentences.lik_tai: ႁဝ်ႇ ဝႃႉ ၼႇ ၵႃ ႁႈ ဢၼ်ႉ ၼႆး ၶဝ်ႊ ယး
sentences.assamese_script: হাও² ৱা⁵ ন² কা¹ হ³ অন⁵ নাই⁴ খাও⁶ য⁴
sentences.free_translation_en: We should take you there in this way.
sentences.speaker: Chaw Sa Myat Chowlik

sentences.text_roman: khaam2 kon2 lung6 khaam2 kon2 yaɯ1 kon2 thau3 khau6
sentences.lik_tai: ၶႃမ်ႇ ၵူၼ်ႇ လုင်ႊ ၶႃမ်ႇ ၵူၼ်ႇ ယ ၵူၼ်ႇ ထဝ်ႈ ၶဝ်ႊ
sentences.assamese_script: খাম² কোন² লুঙ⁶ খাম² কোন² য¹ কোন² থাও³ খাও⁶
sentences.free_translation_en: These are the words of the old people, there is only this much.
sentences.speaker: Chaw Sa Myat Chowlik

sentences.text_roman: kha1 lai4 naai2 au5 tɛk3 wai4 kan5 naa4
sentences.assamese_script: খা¹ লাই⁴ নাই² ঔ⁵ তেক্‌³ ৱাই⁴ কান⁵ না⁴
sentences.free_translation_en: Let us end here.
sentences.speaker: Chaw Sa Myat Chowlik

notes: Traditional counsel on diligence, virtue, respect for elders, and righteous living imparted by elder Chaw Sa Myat Chowlik.

title: Traditional Tai Wisdom and Counsel to Noble Daughters
author: Manuscript in Ancient Tai Script

sentences.text_roman: na1 ta1 phak1
sentences.lik_tai: ၼႃ တႃ ၽၵ်
sentences.assamese_script: না¹ তা¹ ফাক্‌¹
sentences.translation: Blessings.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Blessings.

sentences.text_roman: maɯ2 naang2 khjn2 waai1 tang1 naa3 maa2 khaan1 khuu1
sentences.lik_tai: မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ၶၼ်ႇ ဝႃႆ တင် ၼႃႈ မႃႇ ၶႃၼ် ၶ
sentences.assamese_script: ম² নাঙ² খন² ৱাই¹ তাঙ¹ না³ মা² খান¹ খ¹
sentences.translation: Dear lady, please turn your face, with a smile and laugh.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Dear lady, please turn your face, with a smile and laugh.

sentences.text_roman: khaam2 nii2 sii1 tsuu3 sɯn1 sɯn1 ta1
sentences.lik_tai: ၶႃမ်ႇ ၼႇ ꩢ ၸႈ ꩢိုၼ် ꩢိုၼ် တႃ
sentences.assamese_script: খাম² ন² স¹ চ³ সুন¹ সুন¹ তা¹
sentences.translation: There are four types of the good words of Dharma.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: There are four types of the good words of Dharma.

sentences.text_roman: kau2 tak1 lau2 maɯ2 naang2 hit1 ruu3 ki3 saɯ1 naang2 ɯi2
sentences.lik_tai: ၵဝ်ႇ တၵ် လဝ်ႇ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ႁိတ် ရႈ ၵိႈ ꩢ ၼႃင်ႇ ဢိုႆႇ
sentences.assamese_script: কাও² তাক্‌¹ লাও² ম² নাঙ² হিত্‌¹ ৰ³ কি³ স¹ নাঙ² অুই²
sentences.translation: I will tell you, my lady, so that you may know them and put them in (your mind), oh lady!
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: I will tell you, my lady, so that you may know them and put them in (your mind), oh lady!

sentences.text_roman: an2 waa2 khaam2 nui3 mɯng2 kuu2 nai3 k3 sii1 lak1
sentences.lik_tai: ဢၼ်ႇ ဝႃႇ ၶႃမ်ႇ ၼုႆႈ မိုင်ႇ ၵႇ ၼႆႈ ၵႈ ꩢ လၵ်
sentences.assamese_script: অন² ৱা² খাম² নুই³ মুঙ² ক² নাই³ ক³ স¹ লাক্‌¹
sentences.translation: I will tell these words for the whole earth, for all the four parts, oh my lady.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: I will tell these words for the whole earth, for all the four parts, oh my lady.

sentences.text_roman: kau2 tsau3 tak1 lau2 haɯ2 naang2 nai3
sentences.lik_tai: ၵဝ်ႇ ၸဝ်ႈ တၵ် လဝ်ႇ ႁႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ၼႆႈ
sentences.assamese_script: কাও² চাও³ তাক্‌¹ লাও² হ² নাঙ² নাই³
sentences.translation: I will tell so that you can listen.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: I will tell so that you can listen.

sentences.text_roman: naang2 tsang1 waai1 naa3 tang3 naa3
sentences.lik_tai: ၼႃင်ႇ ၸင် ဝႃႆ ၼႃႈ တင်ႈ ၼႃႈ
sentences.assamese_script: নাঙ² চাঙ¹ ৱাই¹ না³ তাঙ³ না³
sentences.translation: Lady, turn your face and gaze.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Lady, turn your face and gaze.

sentences.text_roman: maa2 khan1
sentences.lik_tai: မႃႇ ၶၼ်
sentences.assamese_script: মা² খান¹
sentences.translation: Come quickly.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Come quickly.

sentences.text_roman: phum1 sng1 tin2 nk3 tsau3
sentences.lik_tai: ၽုမ် ꩢင် တိၼ်ႇ ၼၵ်ႈ ၸဝ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: ফুম¹ সঙ¹ তিন² নক্‌³ চাও³
sentences.translation: From top to toe we make our prayers.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: From top to toe we make our prayers.

sentences.text_roman: kau2 khun1 tak1 lau2 khaam2 tɯ2 ta1 ta1
sentences.lik_tai: ၵဝ်ႇ ၶုၼ် တၵ် လဝ်ႇ ၶႃမ်ႇ တိုႇ တႃ တႃ
sentences.assamese_script: কাও² খুন¹ তাক্‌¹ লাও² খাম² তু² তা¹ তা¹
sentences.translation: I will tell the words of Dharma.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: I will tell the words of Dharma.

sentences.text_roman: haɯ3 naang2 ruu3 sjn1 sing1 ta1
sentences.lik_tai: ႁႈ ၼႃင်ႇ ရႈ ꩢၼ် ꩢိင် တႃ
sentences.assamese_script: হ³ নাঙ² ৰ³ সন¹ সিঙ¹ তা¹
sentences.translation: So that the lady may know the many sounds of the Dharma, think oh Lady!
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: So that the lady may know the many sounds of the Dharma, think oh Lady!

sentences.text_roman: tang1 nii2 tang1 kin2 k3 mau1 tsut3 raai1
sentences.lik_tai: တင် ၼႇ တင် ၵိၼ်ႇ ၵႈ မဝ် ၸုတ်ႈ ရႃႆ
sentences.assamese_script: তাঙ¹ ন² তাঙ¹ কিন² ক³ মাও¹ চুত্‌³ ৰাই¹
sentences.translation: (For in this Dharma), all is good, there is much to eat, and none are poor.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: (For in this Dharma), all is good, there is much to eat, and none are poor.

sentences.text_roman: tang1 kaa1 khng1 kin2 tsam3 yaa1 lɯk3 sju3
sentences.lik_tai: တင် ၵႃ ၶင် ၵိၼ်ႇ ၸမ်ႈ ယႃ လိုၵ်ႈ ꩢႈ
sentences.assamese_script: তাঙ¹ কা¹ খঙ¹ কিন² চাম³ যা¹ লুক্‌³ স³
sentences.translation: Of all the things which are offered to eat, do not choose, but take all.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Of all the things which are offered to eat, do not choose, but take all.

sentences.text_roman: tang1 wan2 tang1 khɯn2 kau2 thɯng1 phaa3 ta1 ta1
sentences.lik_tai: တင် ဝၼ်ႇ တင် ၶိုၼ်ႇ ၵဝ်ႇ ထိုင် ၽႃႈ တႃ တႃ
sentences.assamese_script: তাঙ¹ ৱান² তাঙ¹ খুন² কাও² থুঙ¹ ফা³ তা¹ তা¹
sentences.translation: Both day and night I reach reach towards God, towards Dharma and the teaching.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Both day and night I reach reach towards God, towards Dharma and the teaching.

sentences.text_roman: tang1 khau1 nai3 khau1 au2 tsam3
sentences.lik_tai: တင် ၶဝ် ၼႆႈ ၶဝ် ဢဝ်ႇ ၸမ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: তাঙ¹ খাও¹ নাই³ খাও¹ ঔ² চাম³
sentences.translation: All of this should be taken, don't just read it, put it into your mind.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: All of this should be taken, don't just read it, put it into your mind.

sentences.text_roman: an2 naɯ2 tak1 tsaa3 tsam3 yaa1 haɯ3 maa2
sentences.lik_tai: ဢၼ်ႇ ၼႇ တၵ် ၸႃႈ ၸမ်ႈ ယႃ ႁႈ မႃႇ
sentences.assamese_script: অন² ন² তাক্‌¹ চা³ চাম³ যা¹ হ³ মা²
sentences.translation: Allow (the Dharma) to touch all of your body, Oh Lady!
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Allow (the Dharma) to touch all of your body, Oh Lady!

sentences.text_roman: an2 tak1 saa1 tak1 nan3 tsam3 yaa1 laat3 png1
sentences.lik_tai: ဢၼ်ႇ တၵ် ꩢႃ တၵ် ၼၼ်ႈ ၸမ်ႈ ယႃ လႃတ်ႈ ပင်
sentences.assamese_script: অন² তাক্‌¹ সা¹ তাক্‌¹ নান³ চাম³ যা¹ লাত্‌³ পঙ¹
sentences.translation: Let the good come and do not speak words of complaint.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Let the good come and do not speak words of complaint.

sentences.text_roman: kaa3 maɯ2 naang2 yaa1 pui1 kaau1
sentences.lik_tai: ၵႃႈ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ယႃ ပုႆ ၵႃဝ်
sentences.assamese_script: কা³ ম² নাঙ² যা¹ পুই¹ কাও¹
sentences.translation: Oh lady, you should not ask for the help of spirits, you should not let bad things enter your mind.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Oh lady, you should not ask for the help of spirits, you should not let bad things enter your mind.

sentences.text_roman: an2 hit1 kuu2 tsng3 nai3 k3 maɯ2 naang2
sentences.lik_tai: ဢၼ်ႇ ႁိတ် ၵႇ ၸင်ႈ ၼႆႈ ၵႈ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: অন² হিত্‌¹ ক² চঙ³ নাই³ ক³ ম² নাঙ²
sentences.translation: All types of bad action, oh lady, you should not do.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: All types of bad action, oh lady, you should not do.

sentences.text_roman: khaam2 sui3 yaa1 tɯ2 t1 naa3 naang2 ɯi2
sentences.assamese_script: খাম² সুই³ যা¹ তু² ত¹ না³ নাঙ² অুই²
sentences.translation: Do not speak jealous words, oh Lady!
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Do not speak jealous words, oh Lady!

sentences.text_roman: khaam2 naa1 khaam2 t2 pɯn2 tsam3 yaa1 laat3 png1
sentences.lik_tai: ၶႃမ်ႇ ၼႃ ၶႃမ်ႇ တႇ ပိုၼ်ႇ ၸမ်ႈ ယႃ လႃတ်ႈ ပင်
sentences.assamese_script: খাম² না¹ খাম² ত² পুন² চাম³ যা¹ লাত্‌³ পঙ¹
sentences.translation: Do not speaking abusive or fighting words, and do not complain.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Do not speaking abusive or fighting words, and do not complain.

sentences.text_roman: khaam2 an2 nj2 maɯ1 pɯn2 nam1 maa2 nang1 nai3 tsam3
sentences.lik_tai: ၶႃမ်ႇ ဢၼ်ႇ ၼႇ မ ပိုၼ်ႇ ၼမ် မႃႇ ၼင် ၼႆႈ ၸမ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: খাম² অন² ন² ম¹ পুন² নাম¹ মা² নাঙ¹ নাই³ চাম³
sentences.translation: Words of censuring others like this should not be spoken, oh my Lady!
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Words of censuring others like this should not be spoken, oh my Lady!

sentences.text_roman: khaam2 tsaa3 nai3 tsam3 maɯ2 naang2
sentences.lik_tai: ၶႃမ်ႇ ၸႃႈ ၼႆႈ ၸမ်ႈ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: খাম² চা³ নাই³ চাম³ ম² নাঙ²
sentences.translation: Though bad words may come, oh Lady, leave them aside every day.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Though bad words may come, oh Lady, leave them aside every day.

sentences.text_roman: sang1 phaɯ1 phit1 lung1 k3 maɯ2 naang2 khaɯ3 thɯng1
sentences.lik_tai: ꩢင် ၽ ၽိတ် လုင် ၵႈ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ၶႈ ထိုင်
sentences.assamese_script: সাঙ¹ ফ¹ ফিত্‌¹ লুঙ¹ ক³ ম² নাঙ² খ³ থুঙ¹
sentences.translation: If someone does wrong, oh lady, think well.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: If someone does wrong, oh lady, think well.

sentences.text_roman: yaa1 hit1 luu3 naa3 naang2 ɯi2
sentences.assamese_script: যা¹ হিত্‌¹ ল³ না³ নাঙ² অুই²
sentences.translation: Don't do anything destructive, oh lady!
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Don't do anything destructive, oh lady!

sentences.text_roman: kuu2 wan2 k3 maɯ2 naang2 khaɯ3
sentences.lik_tai: ၵႇ ဝၼ်ႇ ၵႈ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ၶႈ
sentences.assamese_script: ক² ৱান² ক³ ম² নাঙ² খ³
sentences.translation: Every day, Oh lady, you should think and speak diamond words, listen, oh my Lady!
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Every day, Oh lady, you should think and speak diamond words, listen, oh my Lady!

sentences.text_roman: maɯ2 naang2 rɯ1 tak1 sau2 yɯn2 tsuk1 naa3
sentences.lik_tai: မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ရို တၵ် ꩢဝ်ႇ ယိုၼ်ႇ ၸုၵ် ၼႃႈ
sentences.assamese_script: ম² নাঙ² ৰু¹ তাক্‌¹ সাও² যুন² চুক্‌¹ না³
sentences.translation: Oh you lady, how will you remain cool (headed)?
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Oh you lady, how will you remain cool (headed)?

sentences.text_roman: tsam3 maɯ2 naang2 tɯ2 tang1 khaam2 ta1 ta1
sentences.lik_tai: ၸမ်ႈ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ တိုႇ တင် ၶႃမ်ႇ တႃ တႃ
sentences.assamese_script: চাম³ ম² নাঙ² তু² তাঙ¹ খাম² তা¹ তা¹
sentences.translation: If, oh my lady, you hold all the words of Dharma and do not release them, it will be good, oh Lady!
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: If, oh my lady, you hold all the words of Dharma and do not release them, it will be good, oh Lady!

sentences.text_roman: pi2 khai2 nuu2 khai2 aan1 k3
sentences.lik_tai: ပိႇ ၶႆႇ ၼႇ ၶႆႇ ဢႃၼ် ၵႈ
sentences.assamese_script: পি² খাই² ন² খাই² আন¹ ক³
sentences.translation: You should look at and read the words of Dharma, all of them, oh Lady.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: You should look at and read the words of Dharma, all of them, oh Lady.

sentences.text_roman: an2 naɯ1 tak1 nii2 tsam3 maɯ2 naang2 laak1 sju3
sentences.lik_tai: ဢၼ်ႇ ၼ တၵ် ၼႇ ၸမ်ႈ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ လႃၵ် ꩢႈ
sentences.assamese_script: অন² ন¹ তাক্‌¹ ন² চাম³ ম² নাঙ² লাক্‌¹ স³
sentences.translation: Oh, it will be good, my Lady, if you catch (this Dharma).
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Oh, it will be good, my Lady, if you catch (this Dharma).

sentences.text_roman: maɯ2 laak1 au2 khaam2 ta1 ta1 yaa1 phwaa3
sentences.lik_tai: မႇ လႃၵ် ဢဝ်ႇ ၶႃမ်ႇ တႃ တႃ ယႃ ၽႂႃႈ
sentences.assamese_script: ম² লাক্‌¹ ঔ² খাম² তা¹ তা¹ যা¹ ফ্বা³
sentences.translation: If you take the words of Dharma, do not release them.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: If you take the words of Dharma, do not release them.

sentences.text_roman: naɯ2 tsaɯ2 maɯ2 naang2 sng1 yaa1 tsam3 naang2 ɯi2
sentences.lik_tai: ၼႇ ၸႇ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ꩢင် ယႃ ၸမ်ႈ ၼႃင်ႇ ဢိုႆႇ
sentences.assamese_script: ন² চ² ম² নাঙ² সঙ¹ যা¹ চাম³ নাঙ² অুই²
sentences.translation: Put them clearly in your mind, without blemish.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Put them clearly in your mind, without blemish.

sentences.text_roman: p2 nang1 nam3 sjn1 khj2 lai1 png1
sentences.lik_tai: ပႇ ၼင် ၼမ်ႈ ꩢၼ် ၶႇ လႆ ပင်
sentences.assamese_script: প² নাঙ¹ নাম³ সন¹ খ² লাই¹ পঙ¹
sentences.translation: Like the water of many river, (the Dharma) will flow into your mind, like a clear spirit.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Like the water of many river, (the Dharma) will flow into your mind, like a clear spirit.

sentences.text_roman: sjn1 khun1 phaɯ1 nai3 pai2 aap1 maa2 lau2
sentences.lik_tai: ꩢၼ် ၶုၼ် ၽ ၼႆႈ ပႆႇ ဢႃပ် မႃႇ လဝ်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: সন¹ খুন¹ ফ¹ নাই³ পাই² আপ্‌¹ মা² লাও²
sentences.translation: Those many people who (accept the Dharma) will be as bathed in it many times, oh good lady.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Those many people who (accept the Dharma) will be as bathed in it many times, oh good lady.

sentences.location: Sibsagar, Assam (1930 Baptist Mission Press edition)
sentences.notes: Authentic bilingual historical passage from Ahom-Buranji (1930, pp. 44-48, 236-242) documenting Khamjang and the Nora lineage.

sentences.speaker: Rai Sahib Golap Chandra Barua / Deodhai Manuscript
sentences.location: Sibsagar, Assam (1930 Baptist Mission Press edition)
sentences.notes: Authentic bilingual historical passage from Ahom-Buranji (1930, pp. 44-48, 236-242) documenting Khamjang and the Nora lineage.

sentences.speaker: Rai Sahib Golap Chandra Barua / Deodhai Manuscript
sentences.location: Sibsagar, Assam (1930 Baptist Mission Press edition)
sentences.notes: Authentic bilingual historical passage from Ahom-Buranji (1930, pp. 44-48, 236-242) documenting Khamjang and the Nora lineage.

sentences.free_translation_en: The royal host crossed over the high Patkai range and entered the valley of the Buridihing.

sentences.free_translation_en: King Shudangpha sent respectful royal greetings, gifts, and treaties of peace to the Nora Raja.

sentences.speaker: Rai Sahib Golap Chandra Barua / Deodhai Manuscript
sentences.location: Sibsagar, Assam (1930 Baptist Mission Press edition)
sentences.notes: Authentic bilingual historical passage from Ahom-Buranji (1930, pp. 44-48, 236-242) documenting Khamjang and the Nora lineage.

sentences.text_roman: nora1 raa1 jaa1 pan1 maang1 kham1 hai3 chaw3 phaa4

sentences.free_translation_en: The Nora Raja sent celestial blessings, skilled artisans, and astrologers back to the Ahom capital.

sentences.speaker: Rai Sahib Golap Chandra Barua / Deodhai Manuscript
sentences.location: Sibsagar, Assam (1930 Baptist Mission Press edition)
sentences.notes: Authentic bilingual historical passage from Ahom-Buranji (1930, pp. 44-48, 236-242) documenting Khamjang and the Nora lineage.

sentences.free_translation_en: Thus the ancient Ahom-Buranji chronicles preserve the glory of Khamjang and the Nora clans forever.

sentences.speaker: Rai Sahib Golap Chandra Barua / Deodhai Manuscript

notes: Historical chronicle extracted and adapted from Rai Sahib Golap Chandra Barua's landmark 1930 bilingual work 'Ahom-Buranji: From the Earliest Time to the End of Ahom Rule' (Baptist Mission Press, Calcutta), recording Chau Lung Sukapha's arrival in the country of Khamjang, the march of the Thomung and Kalangshu (Chowlik) clans, and diplomatic relations with the Nora Raja.

notes: Primary Assamese Buranji discovered in the archives of the American Baptist Foreign Mission Society in Gauhati, transcribed and critically edited by Dr. S. K. Bhuyan. Records the political, military, and administrative history of Assam from the arrival of Sukapha to the end of King Gadadhar Singha's reign in 1696 A.D. Features authentic Tai-Ahom loanwords, administrative titles (Barbarua, Bargohain, Buragohain), and frontier negotiations with the Nora and Himalayan tribes.

notes: Monumental verse chronicle consisting of Dutiram Hazarika's 'Kali-Bharat Buranji' (1679–1858) and Bisweswar Baidyadhipa's 'Belimarar Buranji' (1780–1845), edited with exhaustive critical apparatus by Dr. S. K. Bhuyan at the Department of Historical and Antiquarian Studies (DHAS), recounting the late Ahom dynasty, the Moamaria rebellions, Burmese wars, and British treaty negotiations in traditional Assamese verse meters.

title: The Place of Assam in the History and Civilisation of India (The Tai Legacy)
title_assamese: ভাৰতৰ ইতিহাস আৰু সভ্যতাত অসমৰ স্থান: টাই অৱদান (ড০ সুনীতিকুমাৰ চট্টোপাধ্যায়, ১৯৭০)
author: Dr. Suniti Kumar Chatterji, M.A., D.Lit. (National Professor of India in Humanities)

sentences.surface_assamese: টাই জনগোষ্ঠীয়ে অসমলৈ আহি ৰাজনৈতিক স্থিৰতা আৰু এক মহান সমন্বয়ৰ সংস্কৃতি গঢ়ি তুলিছিল
sentences.romanization: caao-khə́ tai khao maa nai aa-saam saaŋ pan paai-mə́ŋ lɛ paai-yen-ŋɛ́
sentences.translation_en: The advent of the Tai into Assam bestowed political unification and enriched the composite civilization of India.
sentences.translation_as: টাই জনগোষ্ঠীয়ে অসমলৈ আহি ৰাজনৈতিক স্থিৰতা আৰু এক মহান সমন্বয়ৰ সংস্কৃতি গঢ়ি তুলিছিল।
sentences.notes: Chatterji (1970: 38). Banikanta Kakati Memorial Lectures, Gauhati University.

sentences.surface_assamese: অসম নামটো টাইসকলৰ গৌৰৱোজ্জ্বল ঐতিহ্য আৰু শাসনৰ সৈতে ওতপ্ৰোতভাৱে জড়িত
sentences.romanization: tai pan tsɯ́ mə́ŋ aa-saam lɛ khẃ pɯ́n an hə́-hə́ŋ tɔ wan mə̂ nai
sentences.translation_en: The name of Assam and its historical legacy are indelibly shaped by the magnificent contribution of the Tai.
sentences.translation_as: অসম নামটো টাইসকলৰ গৌৰৱোজ্জ্বল ঐতিহ্য আৰু শাসনৰ সৈতে ওতপ্ৰোতভাৱে জড়িত।
sentences.notes: Chatterji (1970: 42). Etymology and cultural identity of Assam.

sentences.surface_assamese: টাই আৰু অসমীয়া ভাষাৰ সম্প্ৰীতি আৰু ঐতিহাসিক মিলন ভৱিষ্যতৰ বাবে এক অমূল্য পথপ্ৰদৰ্শক
sentences.romanization: lɔ́ŋ phɔ́m-hum nai kɛ́ phaa-saa tai lɛ aa-saam pen tii pɯ́ŋ-iŋ luk-laan
sentences.translation_en: The harmonious synthesis between the Tai and Assamese languages stands as an enduring beacon for posterity.
sentences.translation_as: টাই আৰু অসমীয়া ভাষাৰ সম্প্ৰীতি আৰু ঐতিহাসিক মিলন ভৱিষ্যতৰ বাবে এক অমূল্য পথপ্ৰদৰ্শক।

notes: Distinguished lecture treatise by National Professor Dr. Suniti Kumar Chatterji analyzing the historical role of Assam, the statecraft of the Tai, the origin of the name Assam, and the linguistic synthesis between Tai and Indo-Aryan.

sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: That girl was so beautiful.

notes: The landmark first edition of Sir Edward Gait's definitive history of Assam. Based on direct translations of original Ahom Buranjis, Assamese manuscripts, and Persian chronicles examined under the direction of Gait and Pandit Golap Chandra Barua. Contains the primary historical accounts of Chao Lung Sukapha's 1215-1228 A.D. migration from Mong Mao, crossing the Patkai range into Nora/Khamjang territory, establishing settlements at Khamhangpung and Namrup, bridging the Sessa, and founding the capital at Charaideo.

notes: Standard historical authority by Sir Edward Gait detailing the migration of the Tai races from Upper Burma through the Khamjang valley across the Patkai into the Brahmaputra valley, the status of the Nora raja as ancestral kinsman to the Ahom crown, and the lineage roots of the modern Khamyangs.

notes: Definitive diplomatic history of the military encounters and treaty negotiations between the Tai-Ahom kingdom of Assam and the Mughal Empire between 1600 and 1663 A.D. Analyzes the diplomatic letters (kataki-patras) exchanged between the royal court at Garhgaon and Mughal subahdars (Mir Jumla, Nawab Allah Yar Khan), detailing border demarcations at the Asurar Ali (1639), tribute negotiations, envoy immunities, and trans-Patkai frontier alliances.

notes: Foundational socio-historical treatise analyzing the state formation process in medieval Upper Assam under the Tai Ahom polity. Examines the integration of Tai customary governance, wet-rice hydraulic agriculture, paik labor organization, and kinship alliances with indigenous Tibeto-Burman populations.

notes: Monumental lexicographical masterpiece by missionary-linguist Dr. Ola Hanson. Compiles over 12,000 lexical entries of the Jinghpaw (Kachin) and Singpho language spoken along the Upper Irrawaddy and Patkai borderlands. Contains extensive comparative cross-references to Southwestern Tai (Shan, Khamti, and Khamyang) loanwords, reflecting centuries of trade, intermarriage, and bilingualism between the Tai and Jinghpaw-Singpho peoples.

notes: The definitive enlarged chronicle of Assam written by Harakanta Barua Sadar-Amin, based upon the foundational 1844 work of Kasinath Tamuli-Phukan and critically edited from multiple palm-leaf and sanchi-bark manuscripts by Dr. S. K. Bhuyan. sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The 3rd son, Kham King Pha, was given the Ava country, in Burma.

sentences.text_roman: sai1 tsam3 tsɯ2 kit1
sentences.lik_tai: ꩢႆ ၸမ်ႈ ၸိုႇ ၵိတ်
sentences.assamese_script: সাই¹ চাম³ চু² কিত্‌¹
sentences.translation: The 4th son, called Ket Pha, was given Nuk Cok Nong Mon to rule.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The 4th son, called Ket Pha, was given Nuk Cok Nong Mon to rule.

sentences.text_roman: tsit1 tsam3 phɯ3
sentences.lik_tai: ၸိတ် ၸမ်ႈ ၽိုႈ
sentences.assamese_script: চিত্‌¹ চাম³ ফু³
sentences.translation: The 7th son, Pheu Cang Khang, was given Meng Mit Kup King Nau.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The 7th son, Pheu Cang Khang, was given Meng Mit Kup King Nau.
sentences.notes: * literally 'wizard-elephant-??' Nabin stated that xgq may be 'not straight'.

sentences.text_roman: tsau3 k3 tsang1 waa2 luk3
sentences.lik_tai: ၸဝ်ႈ ၵႈ ၸင် ဝႃႇ လုၵ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: চাও³ ক³ চাঙ¹ ৱা² লুক্‌³
sentences.translation: Chaw Tai Pum said to all his sons, 'Whichever of you love me, I will go to die there.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Chaw Tai Pum said to all his sons, 'Whichever of you love me, I will go to die there.
sentences.notes: Nabin added that he went to Muang Mit, ruled by Pheu Cang Khang, to die there.

sentences.text_roman: mɯ2 nan3 tsau3 k3 sau2 hɯng1
sentences.lik_tai: မိုႇ ၼၼ်ႈ ၸဝ်ႈ ၵႈ ꩢဝ်ႇ ႁိုင်
sentences.assamese_script: মু² নান³ চাও³ ক³ সাও² হুঙ¹
sentences.translation: At that time he was also long lived and had completed so many years (of life).
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: At that time he was also long lived and had completed so many years (of life).

sentences.text_roman: tau2 nuu2 luk3 khai1 tam1 mɯng2
sentences.lik_tai: တဝ်ႇ ၼႇ လုၵ်ႈ ၶႆ တမ် မိုင်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: তাও² ন² লুক্‌³ খাই¹ তাম¹ মুঙ²
sentences.translation: He looked for his royal son, at Muang Mit Keng Nau, and finished his span of life there, (in the place of his forefathers)
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: He looked for his royal son, at Muang Mit Keng Nau, and finished his span of life there, (in the place of his forefathers)
sentences.notes: # Bidya said it was tau1 'PRT', but Shan twq 'seek, search'

sentences.text_roman: mɯ2 pii2 lak1 kap1 taai2 yau3
sentences.lik_tai: မိုႇ ပႇ လၵ် ၵပ် တႃႆႇ ယဝ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: মু² প² লাক্‌¹ কাপ্‌¹ তাই² যাও³
sentences.translation: It was in the Lakni Kap Sang that he died.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: It was in the Lakni Kap Sang that he died.

sentences.text_roman: mɯ2 sii1 nan3 tsau3 miupum
sentences.lik_tai: မိုႇ ꩢ ၼၼ်ႈ ၸဝ်ႈ မမ်
sentences.assamese_script: মু² স¹ নান³ চাও³ মম¹
sentences.translation: After that, Chaw Miu Pum ruled in Meng Mau for one year.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: After that, Chaw Miu Pum ruled in Meng Mau for one year.

sentences.text_roman: lɯt3 maa2 sii1 lj3 mit3 tjng2 kh2 taai2 sii1 yau3
sentences.lik_tai: လိုတ်ႈ မႃႇ ꩢ လႈ မိတ်ႈ တင်ႇ ၶႇ တႃႆႇ ꩢ ယဝ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: লুত্‌³ মা² স¹ ল³ মিত্‌³ তঙ² খ² তাই² স¹ যাও³
sentences.translation: He suffered from high blood pressure and stabbed himself to death.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: He suffered from high blood pressure and stabbed himself to death.
sentences.notes: Nabin explained this as: 'When high pressure is come - he become mad, so he stab himself, he died own self.'

sentences.text_roman: nk3 sii1 nan3 maau2 mau1 yang2 tsau3
sentences.lik_tai: ၼၵ်ႈ ꩢ ၼၼ်ႈ မႃဝ်ႇ မဝ် ယင်ႇ ၸဝ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: নক্‌³ স¹ নান³ মাও² মাও¹ যাঙ² চাও³
sentences.translation: After that, Mau Long did not have a king.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: After that, Mau Long did not have a king.
sentences.notes: * nqk3 sii1 nan3 can be translated as 'after that'

sentences.text_roman: yt3 luk3 tam3
sentences.lik_tai: ယတ်ႈ လုၵ်ႈ တမ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: যত্‌³ লুক্‌³ তাম³
sentences.translation: After that, the God Yot Pha Mok Kham Naeng came down from the heavens and took Chaw Pa Miu Pum's wife to be his own.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: After that, the God Yot Pha Mok Kham Naeng came down from the heavens and took Chaw Pa Miu Pum's wife to be his own.
sentences.notes: * This is the name of a God, literally 'top-heaven-flower-golden-red'

sentences.text_roman: luk3 man2 tsang2 yang2 wai3 luk3 k3 lɯng2
sentences.lik_tai: လုၵ်ႈ မၼ်ႇ ၸင်ႇ ယင်ႇ ဝႆႈ လုၵ်ႈ ၵႈ လိုင်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: লুক্‌³ মান² চাঙ² যাঙ² ৱাই³ লুক্‌³ ক³ লুঙ²
sentences.translation: They had a child whose name was Chaw Su Khan.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: They had a child whose name was Chaw Su Khan.
sentences.notes: Nabin explained this as follows: 'His father is dead, Lengdon has come to married his mother.'

sentences.text_roman: yang2 tsau3 wai3 naɯ2 tuu2 naang2 mɯng2 ki3
sentences.lik_tai: ယင်ႇ ၸဝ်ႈ ဝႆႈ ၼႇ တႇ ၼႃင်ႇ မိုင်ႇ ၵိႈ
sentences.assamese_script: যাঙ² চাও³ ৱাই³ ন² ত² নাঙ² মুঙ² কি³
sentences.translation: At the time when Chaw Su Khan was still in the Queen's womb, the God Yot Pha Mok Kham Naeng returned to heaven.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: At the time when Chaw Su Khan was still in the Queen's womb, the God Yot Pha Mok Kham Naeng returned to heaven.

sentences.text_roman: tsau3 tai2 tsang1 uu1 mɯng2
sentences.lik_tai: ၸဝ်ႈ တႆႇ ၸင် ဢ မိုင်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: চাও³ তাই² চাঙ¹ অ¹ মুঙ²
sentences.translation: Chaw Tai Lung lived at Muang Yon
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Chaw Tai Lung lived at Muang Yon

sentences.text_roman: maa2 au2 mj2 tsau3 k1
sentences.lik_tai: မႃႇ ဢဝ်ႇ မႇ ၸဝ်ႈ ၵ
sentences.assamese_script: মা² ঔ² ম² চাও³ ক¹
sentences.translation: He came and took the mother of Chaw Su Khan,
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: He came and took the mother of Chaw Su Khan,

sentences.text_roman: tsang1 yang2 tsau3 ki3
sentences.lik_tai: ၸင် ယင်ႇ ၸဝ်ႈ ၵိႈ
sentences.assamese_script: চাঙ¹ যাঙ² চাও³ কি³
sentences.translation: They bore (a son) Chaw Sam Lung Kam Ko.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: They bore (a son) Chaw Sam Lung Kam Ko.

sentences.text_roman: paan2 waa2 nui3 khɯ2 tsau3
sentences.assamese_script: পান² ৱা² নুই³ খু² চাও³
sentences.translation: From this part, (we will tell) the history of Chaw Pha Long, of Meng Kong Country. Listen all!
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: From this part, (we will tell) the history of Chaw Pha Long, of Meng Kong Country. Listen all!
sentences.notes: This is a promise not kept. Nabin does not know who Chaw Pha Long is, although perhaps it is another name of Phreu Cang Khang. See 27 below.

sentences.text_roman: haa1 nai3 ta1 maa2 laat3 nui3
sentences.assamese_script: হা¹ নাই³ তা¹ মা² লাত্‌³ নুই³
sentences.translation: Now we will speak of Phreu Cang Khang of the royal caste
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Now we will speak of Phreu Cang Khang of the royal caste

sentences.text_roman: sau2 phring1 ho1 mau1 pi1 khun1 khɯ3
sentences.lik_tai: ꩢဝ်ႇ ၽင် ႁူ မဝ် ပိ ၶုၼ် ၶိုႈ
sentences.assamese_script: সাও² ফঙ¹ হো¹ মাও¹ পি¹ খুন¹ খু³
sentences.translation: He was staying quietly in the palace, he was not such an important king
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: He was staying quietly in the palace, he was not such an important king
sentences.notes: * This word occurs frequently in likqhogqxonq. Perhaps Shan fVgqG 'be even, as much as; be without inequalities' [phjN]

sentences.text_roman: man2 tsau3 pin2 tsau3 tam1 mɯng2
sentences.lik_tai: မၼ်ႇ ၸဝ်ႈ ပိၼ်ႇ ၸဝ်ႈ တမ် မိုင်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: মান² চাও³ পিন² চাও³ তাম¹ মুঙ²
sentences.translation: He was the King in Meng Mit Kup King Nau country
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: He was the King in Meng Mit Kup King Nau country

sentences.text_roman: aa1 man2 tsau3 nai3 tsit1 pii2 taai2 yau3
sentences.lik_tai: ဢႃ မၼ်ႇ ၸဝ်ႈ ၼႆႈ ၸိတ် ပႇ တႃႆႇ ယဝ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: আ¹ মান² চাও³ নাই³ চিত্‌¹ প² তাই² যাও³
sentences.translation: At the age of seventy he died.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: At the age of seventy he died.

sentences.text_roman: luk3 man2 tsau3
sentences.lik_tai: လုၵ်ႈ မၼ်ႇ ၸဝ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: লুক্‌³ মান² চাও³
sentences.translation: His son was Chaw Su Yot Pha
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: His son was Chaw Su Yot Pha

sentences.text_roman: man2 tsau3 haɯ3 pai2 kin2 tai2 ki3
sentences.lik_tai: မၼ်ႇ ၸဝ်ႈ ႁႈ ပႆႇ ၵိၼ်ႇ တႆႇ ၵိႈ
sentences.assamese_script: মান² চাও³ হ³ পাই² কিন² তাই² কি³
sentences.translation: He got to rule in Tai Em.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: He got to rule in Tai Em.
sentences.notes: Nabin stated that this is possibly the same place as Muang Eu - see above number 3.

sentences.text_roman: luk3 tsaai2 khɯng2 tsam3 sɯ1
sentences.assamese_script: লুক্‌³ চাই² খুঙ² চাম³ সু¹
sentences.translation: His middle son's name was Su Kham Pha.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: His middle son's name was Su Kham Pha.

sentences.text_roman: haɯ3 kaa1 kin2 tai2 ki3
sentences.lik_tai: ႁႈ ၵႃ ၵိၼ်ႇ တႆႇ ၵိႈ
sentences.assamese_script: হ³ কা¹ কিন² তাই² কি³
sentences.translation: He was given Tai Pong (country) to rule.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: He was given Tai Pong (country) to rule.

sentences.text_roman: luk3 tsaa2 ki3 sɯ1
sentences.assamese_script: লুক্‌³ চা² কি³ সু¹
sentences.translation: The youngest child was called Sukapha
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The youngest child was called Sukapha

sentences.text_roman: haɯ3 kin2 mɯng2 kau1 yau3
sentences.lik_tai: ႁႈ ၵိၼ်ႇ မိုင်ႇ ၵဝ် ယဝ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: হ³ কিন² মুঙ² কাও¹ যাও³
sentences.translation: He was given the old country to rule.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: He was given the old country to rule.
sentences.notes: This refers to Muang Mit, now in Shan State.

sentences.text_roman: mɯ2 nan3 khuu2 tsau3 sɯ1
sentences.lik_tai: မိုႇ ၼၼ်ႈ ၶႇ ၸဝ်ႈ ꩢို
sentences.assamese_script: মু² নান³ খ² চাও³ সু¹
sentences.translation: Then the soldiers of Chaw Su Khan Pha, who were coming to kill Cau Tai Lung, came to Su Ka Pha.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Then the soldiers of Chaw Su Khan Pha, who were coming to kill Cau Tai Lung, came to Su Ka Pha.
sentences.notes: Nabin explained that this meant that Su Khan Pha planned to call Su Ka Pha to come to kill Chaw Tai Lung.'

sentences.text_roman: tsau3 sɯ1 sup1 lui2 tsaɯ2 maa3
sentences.lik_tai: ၸဝ်ႈ ꩢို ꩢုပ် လုႆႇ ၸႇ မႃႈ
sentences.assamese_script: চাও³ সু¹ সুপ্‌¹ লুই² চ² মা³
sentences.translation: Therefore Sukapha was deeply disturbed and afraid.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Therefore Sukapha was deeply disturbed and afraid.
sentences.notes: Nabin explained that the reason for Sukapha's distress was that he did not want to kill Chaw Tai Long.

sentences.text_roman: tsang1 pai2 mɯng2 paa3 taɯ3 nai3 h1
sentences.lik_tai: ၸင် ပႆႇ မိုင်ႇ ပႃႈ တႈ ၼႆႈ ႁ
sentences.assamese_script: চাঙ¹ পাই² মুঙ² পা³ ত³ নাই³ হ¹
sentences.translation: He (decided) that he would go down to Assam.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: He (decided) that he would go down to Assam.
sentences.notes: m*N2 nun2 'cotton country' is the Tai name for Assam.

sentences.text_roman: waai2 tsau3 pai2 maa2 yau3 tsam3
sentences.lik_tai: ဝႃႆႇ ၸဝ်ႈ ပႆႇ မႃႇ ယဝ်ႈ ၸမ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: ৱাই² চাও³ পাই² মা² যাও³ চাম³
sentences.translation: Narrative passage 40.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Narrative passage 40.

sentences.text_roman: tsau3 sɯ1 tsang1 maa2
sentences.lik_tai: ၸဝ်ႈ ꩢို ၸင် မႃႇ
sentences.assamese_script: চাও³ সু¹ চাঙ¹ মা²
sentences.translation: When Sukapha had gone (to Assam), Chaw Su Khan Pha came and took the son of Chaw Su Yot Pha.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: When Sukapha had gone (to Assam), Chaw Su Khan Pha came and took the son of Chaw Su Yot Pha.

sentences.text_roman: luk3 tsaai3 sɯ1 tsam3 tsau3 nam1
sentences.lik_tai: လုၵ်ႈ ၸႃႆႈ ꩢို ၸမ်ႈ ၸဝ်ႈ ၼမ်
sentences.assamese_script: লুক্‌³ চাই³ সু¹ চাম³ চাও³ নাম¹
sentences.translation: The son of Su Yot Pha was Chaw Tai Ciu.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The son of Su Yot Pha was Chaw Tai Ciu.
sentences.notes: Nabin stated that the meaning of ciwq ciu is not known, probably the name of a place.

sentences.text_roman: tang1 k3 luk3
sentences.lik_tai: တင် ၵႈ လုၵ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: তাঙ¹ ক³ লুক্‌³
sentences.translation: So everybody was descended from Pheu Cang Khang
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: So everybody was descended from Pheu Cang Khang

sentences.text_roman: hang2 tsau3 tsam3 haɯ3 pai2 kin2 m3 ki3
sentences.lik_tai: ႁင်ႇ ၸဝ်ႈ ၸမ်ႈ ႁႈ ပႆႇ ၵိၼ်ႇ မႈ ၵိႈ
sentences.assamese_script: হাঙ² চাও³ চাম³ হ³ পাই² কিন² ম³ কি³
sentences.translation: He (Su Khan Pha) let Chaw Tai Ciu go to rule in Mau Wu.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: He (Su Khan Pha) let Chaw Tai Ciu go to rule in Mau Wu.

sentences.text_roman: uu1 m3 nai3
sentences.lik_tai: ဢ မႈ ၼႆႈ
sentences.assamese_script: অ¹ ম³ নাই³
sentences.translation: From  Mo Wu he came to rule to Kang Taeu Phake country.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: From  Mo Wu he came to rule to Kang Taeu Phake country.
sentences.notes: Nabin stated that the Phakes came from this place, Kang Taue Phake. The original home of the Aitons was also called Aiton. At that time there were three countries Muang Aiton, Muang Phake and Muang Khamyang.

sentences.text_roman: tsau3 tsang1 waa2
sentences.lik_tai: ၸဝ်ႈ ၸင် ဝႃႇ
sentences.assamese_script: চাও³ চাঙ¹ ৱা²
sentences.translation: Cau Tai Ciu had said, my country (has become) old, so I will come and stay here. This is what he said.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Cau Tai Ciu had said, my country (has become) old, so I will come and stay here. This is what he said.

sentences.text_roman: waai2 nan3 sau2 hɯng1 thun3 laai1 pii2 thaap3
sentences.lik_tai: ဝႃႆႇ ၼၼ်ႈ ꩢဝ်ႇ ႁိုင် ထုၼ်ႈ လႃႆ ပႇ ထႃပ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: ৱাই² নান³ সাও² হুঙ¹ থুন³ লাই¹ প² থাপ্‌³
sentences.translation: After that he stayed many years.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: After that he stayed many years.
sentences.notes: Nabin stated that thap tang means 'finished already, closed., last year have not seen, another year come'  possibly Shan vBpqH 'place one on another'.

sentences.text_roman: thɯng1 maa2 laak3
sentences.assamese_script: থুঙ¹ মা² লাক্‌³
sentences.translation: There came a time, in that ancient period, when Chaw Khai Pha Tai Khang (became king).
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: There came a time, in that ancient period, when Chaw Khai Pha Tai Khang (became king).
sentences.notes: * literally 'top-RESP-egg-sky-Tai' Nabin stated that khang means the tribal people that are living in the hills.

sentences.text_roman: mɯ2 nan3 tsau3 tsang1 waa2
sentences.lik_tai: မိုႇ ၼၼ်ႈ ၸဝ်ႈ ၸင် ဝႃႇ

sentences.lik_tai: ဢင်ႈ ၼႈ ဢၼ်ႇ ၽတ် ၶဝ်ႈ ၼႈ
sentences.assamese_script: অঙ³ ন³ অন² ফাত্‌¹ খাও³ ন³
sentences.translation: A duN3 is something we use for winnowing rice.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: A duN3 is something we use for winnowing rice.

sentences.text_roman: an2 phat1 khau3 nj3 waa2 dung3
sentences.lik_tai: ဢၼ်ႇ ၽတ် ၶဝ်ႈ ၼႈ ဝႃႇ ဢင်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: অন² ফাত্‌¹ খাও³ ন³ ৱা² অঙ³
sentences.translation: The thing we use for winnowing rice is called duN3.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The thing we use for winnowing rice is called duN3.

sentences.text_roman: naɯ2 dung3 nj3 saɯ1 sii1
sentences.lik_tai: ၼႇ ဢင်ႈ ၼႈ ꩢ ꩢ
sentences.assamese_script: ন² অঙ³ ন³ স¹ স¹
sentences.translation: Into this winnowing basket we put all types of things.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Into this winnowing basket we put all types of things.

sentences.text_roman: njw1 pa1 xw1 xw1 suk1 xj1 kj1 pun1 es1 nn1 nɯ3 paa2 khau3 khau3 suk1 khai1 kai1 pun3 sj1 nan3
sentences.lik_tai: ၼဝ် ပႃ ဢဝ် ဢဝ် ꩢုၵ် ဢ ၵ ပုၼ် ဢ ၼၼ် ၼိုႈ ပႃႇ ၶဝ်ႈ ၶဝ်ႈ ꩢုၵ် ၶႆ ၵႆ ပုၼ်ႈ ꩢ ၼၼ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: নৱ¹ পা¹ অৱ¹ অৱ¹ সুক্‌¹ অ¹ ক¹ পুন¹ অ¹ নন¹ নু³ পা² খাও³ খাও³ সুক্‌¹ খাই¹ কাই¹ পুন³ স¹ নান³
sentences.translation: Meat, fish, rice, fresh rice, egg, chicken, and some others.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Meat, fish, rice, fresh rice, egg, chicken, and some others.
sentences.notes: Nabin stated that pun3 should be translated as 'others'.

sentences.text_roman: khɯng2 an2
sentences.lik_tai: ၶိုင်ႇ ဢၼ်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: খুঙ² অন²
sentences.translation: These things ...
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: These things ...

sentences.text_roman: aa1 ta1 hng3 khn1 nai3
sentences.lik_tai: ဢႃ တႃ ႁင်ႈ ၶၼ် ၼႆႈ
sentences.assamese_script: আ¹ তা¹ হঙ³ খন¹ নাই³
sentences.translation: We will do the work of calling the khon (with them).
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: We will do the work of calling the khon (with them).

sentences.text_roman: an2 hng3 mɯn2 nj3
sentences.lik_tai: ဢၼ်ႇ ႁင်ႈ မိုၼ်ႇ ၼႈ
sentences.assamese_script: অন² হঙ³ মুন² ন³
sentences.translation: In calling it we use the hoe, the axe, the sword and sticks.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: In calling it we use the hoe, the axe, the sword and sticks.

sentences.text_roman: j1 ljm3 kung2 nang1 tang1 waa2 wai3 kum1
sentences.lik_tai: ဢ လမ်ႈ ၵုင်ႇ ၼင် တင် ဝႃႇ ဝႆႈ ၵုမ်
sentences.assamese_script: অ¹ লম³ কুঙ² নাঙ¹ তাঙ¹ ৱা² ৱাই³ কুম¹
sentences.translation: As well as bows and arrows, all gathered together.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: As well as bows and arrows, all gathered together.

sentences.text_roman: au2 wai3 kum1 sj1 waa2 tsau3 hng3 khn1 nj3
sentences.lik_tai: ဢဝ်ႇ ဝႆႈ ၵုမ် ꩢ ဝႃႇ ၸဝ်ႈ ႁင်ႈ ၶၼ် ၼႈ
sentences.assamese_script: ঔ² ৱাই³ কুম¹ স¹ ৱা² চাও³ হঙ³ খন¹ ন³
sentences.translation: All these are gathered together by the person we call the caller of the khon.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: All these are gathered together by the person we call the caller of the khon.

sentences.text_roman: sa1 an2 hng3 khn1 nj3 ta1 hng3 sj1
sentences.lik_tai: ꩢႃ ဢၼ်ႇ ႁင်ႈ ၶၼ် ၼႈ တႃ ႁင်ႈ ꩢ
sentences.assamese_script: সা¹ অন² হঙ³ খন¹ ন³ তা¹ হঙ³ স¹
sentences.translation: The teacher who calls the khon, who will call it.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The teacher who calls the khon, who will call it.

sentences.text_roman: khn1 nj3 haɯ3 pk3 man2
sentences.lik_tai: ၶၼ် ၼႈ ႁႈ ပၵ်ႈ မၼ်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: খন¹ ন³ হ³ পক্‌³ মান²
sentences.translation: For the khon to return to him (i.e. the sick child).
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: For the khon to return to him (i.e. the sick child).

sentences.text_roman: khn1 j1 waa2 mɯ2 kaa1 pai2 kaa1 pai2
sentences.lik_tai: ၶၼ် ဢ ဝႃႇ မိုႇ ၵႃ ပႆႇ ၵႃ ပႆႇ
sentences.assamese_script: খন¹ অ¹ ৱা² মু² কা¹ পাই² কা¹ পাই²
sentences.translation: Wherever that khon has escaped to, (he) will get it to come back, to call it back.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Wherever that khon has escaped to, (he) will get it to come back, to call it back.

sentences.text_roman: sang1 waa2 kaa1 au2 j1 wai3 sang1 waa2 tii2 uu1
sentences.lik_tai: ꩢင် ဝႃႇ ၵႃ ဢဝ်ႇ ဢ ဝႆႈ ꩢင် ဝႃႇ တႇ ဢ
sentences.assamese_script: সাঙ¹ ৱা² কা¹ ঔ² অ¹ ৱাই³ সাঙ¹ ৱা² ত² অ¹
sentences.translation: If it has gone to live in a place where bad khons are,
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: If it has gone to live in a place where bad khons are,

sentences.text_roman: tii2 saang2 nang1
sentences.lik_tai: တႇ ꩢႃင်ႇ ၼင်
sentences.assamese_script: ত² সাঙ² নাঙ¹
sentences.translation: Like to a burial place.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Like to a burial place.

sentences.text_roman: au2 waai1 pai2 tuk3 maa2
sentences.assamese_script: ঔ² ৱাই¹ পাই² তুক্‌³ মা²
sentences.translation: Take rattan and beat it and get it to come back.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Take rattan and beat it and get it to come back.

sentences.text_roman: sang1 waa2 lj1 kaa1 uu1 kaa1 j1
sentences.lik_tai: ꩢင် ဝႃႇ လ ၵႃ ဢ ၵႃ ဢ
sentences.assamese_script: সাঙ¹ ৱা² ল¹ কা¹ অ¹ কা¹ অ¹
sentences.translation: If it goes to stay at, umm, then take an axe and beat it out from those bad spirits.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: If it goes to stay at, umm, then take an axe and beat it out from those bad spirits.
sentences.notes: Nabin stated that he meant to say that the khon had gone to a forest (na*2 th*n1)

sentences.text_roman: tsaa2 phii1 phjt1 tsaa3 nan3 au2 khaan1 au2 daap1
sentences.lik_tai: ၸႃႇ ၽ ၽတ် ၸႃႈ ၼၼ်ႈ ဢဝ်ႇ ၶႃၼ် ဢဝ်ႇ ဢပ်
sentences.assamese_script: চা² ফ¹ ফত্‌¹ চা³ নান³ ঔ² খান¹ ঔ² অপ্‌¹
sentences.translation: Take an axe and a sword to those bad spirits and cut them.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Take an axe and a sword to those bad spirits and cut them.

sentences.text_roman: au2 pk3 maa2 hang2 khn1 nai3
sentences.lik_tai: ဢဝ်ႇ ပၵ်ႈ မႃႇ ႁင်ႇ ၶၼ် ၼႆႈ
sentences.assamese_script: ঔ² পক্‌³ মা² হাঙ² খন¹ নাই³
sentences.translation: Make this khon return!
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Make this khon return!

sentences.text_roman: waa2 hit1 nang1 nat3 tang3 mɯ2 mɯ2 tam3 tii2 j1 nai3
sentences.lik_tai: ဝႃႇ ႁိတ် ၼင် ၼတ်ႈ တင်ႈ မိုႇ မိုႇ တမ်ႈ တႇ ဢ ၼႆႈ
sentences.assamese_script: ৱা² হিত্‌¹ নাঙ¹ নাত্‌³ তাঙ³ মু² মু² তাম³ ত² অ¹ নাই³
sentences.translation: It should be done like this, to bow before the spirits at the place where this is set up.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: It should be done like this, to bow before the spirits at the place where this is set up.

sentences.text_roman: ti1 hng3 khn1 nai3 khau3 suk1
sentences.lik_tai: တိ ႁင်ႈ ၶၼ် ၼႆႈ ၶဝ်ႈ ꩢုၵ်
sentences.assamese_script: তি¹ হঙ³ খন¹ নাই³ খাও³ সুক্‌¹
sentences.translation: He will call the spirits with cooked rice and rice bound up in a leaf.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: He will call the spirits with cooked rice and rice bound up in a leaf.

sentences.text_roman: kup1 tang1 khai1 kai1 kup1 tang1 nɯ3 tang1 paa2 tang1
sentences.lik_tai: ၵုပ် တင် ၶႆ ၵႆ ၵုပ် တင် ၼိုႈ တင် ပႃႇ တင်
sentences.assamese_script: কুপ্‌¹ তাঙ¹ খাই¹ কাই¹ কুপ্‌¹ তাঙ¹ নু³ তাঙ¹ পা² তাঙ¹
sentences.translation: With all types of (food), namely egg, chicken, meat and fish.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: With all types of (food), namely egg, chicken, meat and fish.

sentences.text_roman: nang1 nai3 waa2
sentences.lik_tai: ၼင် ၼႆႈ ဝႃႇ
sentences.assamese_script: নাঙ¹ নাই³ ৱা²
sentences.translation: We say like that
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: We say like that

sentences.text_roman: mɯ2 khn1 j1 ta1 thin1 kaa1 hang2 kun2
sentences.lik_tai: မိုႇ ၶၼ် ဢ တႃ ထိၼ် ၵႃ ႁင်ႇ ၵုၼ်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: মু² খন¹ অ¹ তা¹ থিন¹ কা¹ হাঙ² কুন²
sentences.translation: Then the khon will be sent to the person.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Then the khon will be sent to the person.

sentences.text_roman: kaa1 sn3 maa2
sentences.lik_tai: ၵႃ ꩢၼ်ႈ မႃႇ
sentences.assamese_script: কা¹ সন³ মা²
sentences.translation: Going to catch (it) by catching fish.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Going to catch (it) by catching fish.

sentences.text_roman: an2 nan3 waa2 sn3 khn1 waa2
sentences.lik_tai: ဢၼ်ႇ ၼၼ်ႈ ဝႃႇ ꩢၼ်ႈ ၶၼ် ဝႃႇ
sentences.assamese_script: অন² নান³ ৱা² সন³ খন¹ ৱা²
sentences.translation: This is called sqn3 khqn1.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: This is called sqn3 khqn1.

sentences.text_roman: au2 khɯk1 nj3 kaa1 sn3 mɯ2 nan3 dai3 sang1 maa2
sentences.lik_tai: ဢဝ်ႇ ၶိုၵ် ၼႈ ၵႃ ꩢၼ်ႈ မိုႇ ၼၼ်ႈ ဢႈ ꩢင် မႃႇ
sentences.assamese_script: ঔ² খুক্‌¹ ন³ কা¹ সন³ মু² নান³ অ³ সাঙ¹ মা²
sentences.translation: Take a fishing implement and go and catch it like a fish, and if you get anything, bring it back and keep it.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Take a fishing implement and go and catch it like a fish, and if you get anything, bring it back and keep it.

sentences.text_roman: ta1 maa2 wai3 tii2 tsj2 mɯ2
sentences.assamese_script: তা¹ মা² ৱাই³ ত² চ² মু²
sentences.translation: And it will be done by that caller (of the khon).
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: And it will be done by that caller (of the khon).

sentences.text_roman: tsau3 hng3 man2 khaam2 mɯn2 nai3 ta1 waa2
sentences.lik_tai: ၸဝ်ႈ ႁင်ႈ မၼ်ႇ ၶႃမ်ႇ မိုၼ်ႇ ၼႆႈ တႃ ဝႃႇ
sentences.assamese_script: চাও³ হঙ³ মান² খাম² মুন² নাই³ তা¹ ৱা²
sentences.translation: The caller of the khon says these words, and these words reach the khon in this manner.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The caller of the khon says these words, and these words reach the khon in this manner.

sentences.text_roman: thɯng1 maa2 tii2 daɯ1 k3 ta1 waa2 kaa1
sentences.lik_tai: ထိုင် မႃႇ တႇ ဢ ၵႈ တႃ ဝႃႇ ၵႃ
sentences.assamese_script: থুঙ¹ মা² ত² অ¹ ক³ তা¹ ৱা² কা¹
sentences.translation: Where it comes to, will be said.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Where it comes to, will be said.

sentences.text_roman: an2 ti1 tɯ2 au2 mit3 au2 phaa3
sentences.lik_tai: ဢၼ်ႇ တိ တိုႇ ဢဝ်ႇ မိတ်ႈ ဢဝ်ႇ ၽႃႈ
sentences.assamese_script: অন² তি¹ তু² ঔ² মিত্‌³ ঔ² ফা³
sentences.translation: Taking those utensils, the knife, cleaver, sword and stick, will call it to come.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Taking those utensils, the knife, cleaver, sword and stick, will call it to come.

sentences.text_roman: ta1 hng3 maa2 nang1 nat3 yau3
sentences.lik_tai: တႃ ႁင်ႈ မႃႇ ၼင် ၼတ်ႈ ယဝ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: তা¹ হঙ³ মা² নাঙ¹ নাত্‌³ যাও³
sentences.translation: It will be called like that.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: It will be called like that.

sentences.text_roman: sang1 waa3 dai3 maa2 an2 j1 au2
sentences.lik_tai: ꩢင် ဝႃႈ ဢႈ မႃႇ ဢၼ်ႇ ဢ ဢဝ်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: সাঙ¹ ৱা³ অ³ মা² অন² অ¹ ঔ²
sentences.translation: If they get eggs, the yolk of eggs, ...
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: If they get eggs, the yolk of eggs, ...

sentences.text_roman: khai1 kai1 nan3
sentences.lik_tai: ၶႆ ၵႆ ၼၼ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: খাই¹ কাই¹ নান³
sentences.translation: Those chicken eggs
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Those chicken eggs

sentences.text_roman: tii2 kun2 khai3 luk3 nan3
sentences.lik_tai: တႇ ၵုၼ်ႇ ၶႆႈ လုၵ်ႈ ၼၼ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: ত² কুন² খাই³ লুক্‌³ নান³
sentences.translation: For that sick child.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: For that sick child.

sentences.text_roman: tii2 khai3 nan3
sentences.lik_tai: တႇ ၶႆႈ ၼၼ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: ত² খাই³ নান³
sentences.translation: The one who is ill.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The one who is ill.

sentences.text_roman: tii2 kun2 khai3 ta1 kaa1 tsik1 tii2 khn1
sentences.lik_tai: တႇ ၵုၼ်ႇ ၶႆႈ တႃ ၵႃ ၸိၵ် တႇ ၶၼ်
sentences.assamese_script: ত² কুন² খাই³ তা¹ কা¹ চিক্‌¹ ত² খন¹
sentences.translation: The khon will go to the tip of the head of that sick child, there are khons there.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The khon will go to the tip of the head of that sick child, there are khons there.

sentences.text_roman: khn1 uu1
sentences.lik_tai: ၶၼ် ဢ
sentences.assamese_script: খন¹ অ¹
sentences.translation: Where is the khon ...
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Where is the khon ...

sentences.text_roman: khn1 uu1 nɯ1 tsik1 huu1
sentences.lik_tai: ၶၼ် ဢ ၼို ၸိၵ် ႁ
sentences.assamese_script: খন¹ অ¹ নু¹ চিক্‌¹ হ¹
sentences.translation: The khon is at the top of the head.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The khon is at the top of the head.

sentences.text_roman: uu1 nɯ1 ho1
sentences.lik_tai: ဢ ၼို ႁူ
sentences.assamese_script: অ¹ নু¹ হো¹
sentences.translation: It is above the head.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: It is above the head.
sentences.notes: SM pronounces in the Phake way [ho6]

sentences.text_roman: uu1 nɯ1 ho1 nan3 au2 khai1 kai1
sentences.lik_tai: ဢ ၼို ႁူ ၼၼ်ႈ ဢဝ်ႇ ၶႆ ၵႆ
sentences.assamese_script: অ¹ নু¹ হো¹ নান³ ঔ² খাই¹ কাই¹
sentences.translation: Bring the chicken eggs, the yolk of the eggs, to the top of the head, he will wipe it saying Ci Cup Ci Cup Ci Cup.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Bring the chicken eggs, the yolk of the eggs, to the top of the head, he will wipe it saying Ci Cup Ci Cup Ci Cup.

sentences.text_roman: ɯ2 ta1 waa2 tsiitsup
sentences.lik_tai: ဢိုႇ တႃ ဝႃႇ ၸပ်
sentences.assamese_script: উ² তা¹ ৱা² চপ্‌¹
sentences.translation: Yes, he will say Ci Cup.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Yes, he will say Ci Cup.

title: A Statistical Account of Assam: The Tai Nora, Khamti and Ahom Settlements

sentences.surface_assamese: শিৱসাগৰ জিলাত টাই-নোৰা আৰু খামতিসকলৰ ওখ চাংঘৰৰ পৰম্পৰাগত গাঁও আছিল

sentences.translation_en: The Tai Nora and Khamti maintained traditional stilt-house villages in the Sibsagar and Lakhimpur districts.
sentences.translation_as: শিৱসাগৰ জিলাত টাই-নোৰা আৰু খামতিসকলৰ ওখ চাংঘৰৰ পৰম্পৰাগত গাঁও আছিল।
sentences.notes: Hunter (1879: Vol. I, p. 238). Statistical Account of Assam (Sibsagar).

sentences.surface_tai: ၶဝ် မီး ဝတ်ႉ ၵျွင်း တီႈ ၵၢင် ဝၢၼ်ႈ မီး ပပ်ႉ ထမ်း ပႃႇလိ လႄႈ လိၵ်ႈ တႆး
sentences.surface_assamese: গাঁৱৰ কেন্দ্ৰস্থলত বৌদ্ধ বিহাৰ আৰু তাত পালি ধৰ্মশাস্ত্ৰ আৰু টাই পুথি সংৰক্ষিত আছিল
sentences.romanization: khao mii wat kyaoŋ tii kaaŋ waan mii pap tham paa-li lɛ lik tai
sentences.translation_en: At the center of their villages stood the Buddhist monastery preserving sacred Pali scriptures and Tai manuscripts.
sentences.translation_as: গাঁৱৰ কেন্দ্ৰস্থলত বৌদ্ধ বিহাৰ আৰু তাত পালি ধৰ্মশাস্ত্ৰ আৰু টাই পুথি সংৰক্ষিত আছিল।
sentences.notes: Hunter (1879: Vol. I, p. 242). Monastic literature and religious institutions.

sentences.surface_tai: ၵူၼ် တႆး ပဵၼ် ၸၢဝ်း ႁၵ်ႉ လွင်ႈ ၽွမ်ႉႁူမ်ႈ ၸွႆႈထႅမ် ၵၼ် ၼႂ်း ၵၢၼ် ၼႃး
sentences.surface_assamese: টাইসকল ভাতৃত্ববোধ আৰু একতাৰে ভৰপূৰ আছিল আৰু খেতিৰ কামত পৰস্পৰে সহায় কৰিছিল
sentences.romanization: kon tai pen caao hak lɔ́ŋ phɔ́m-hum tsɔi-thɛm kan nai kaan naa
sentences.translation_en: The Tai were deeply united by communal solidarity, cooperating harmoniously in reciprocal wet-rice agriculture.
sentences.translation_as: টাইসকল ভাতৃত্ববোধ আৰু একতাৰে ভৰপূৰ আছিল আৰু খেতিৰ কামত পৰস্পৰে সহায় কৰিছিল।
sentences.notes: Hunter (1879: Vol. I, p. 245). Cooperative farming and community cohesion.

notes: Sir W. W. Hunter's landmark statistical gazetteer detailing the demographics, Theravada Buddhist monasteries, Pali-Tai manuscripts, stilt house architecture, and agricultural life of the Tai Nora, Khamti, and Ahoms in Sibsagar and Lakhimpur.

sentences.surface_assamese: শ্বান ৰাজ্যসমূহ স্বতন্ত্ৰ চাওফা বা টাই ৰজাসকলৰ দ্বাৰা সুন্দৰভাৱে শাসিত হৈছিল

sentences.translation_en: Across the highland Shan principalities, each Tai state was governed by its autonomous Saopha.

sentences.surface_assamese: মোগাং আৰু খামতি লোং অঞ্চলৰ অসমৰ সৈতে যুগ যুগ ধৰি ঐতিহাসিক আৰু সাংস্কৃতিক সংযোগ আছিল

sentences.translation_en: The realms of Mogaung and Khamti Long maintained unbroken historical and cultural ties with Upper Assam across the Patkai passes.
sentences.translation_as: মোগাং আৰু খামতি লোং অঞ্চলৰ অসমৰ সৈতে যুগ যুগ ধৰি ঐতিহাসিক আৰু সাংস্কৃতিক সংযোগ আছিল।
sentences.notes: Imperial Gazetteer (1908: 104). The northern frontier and historical Shan ties to Assam.

sentences.surface_tai: ၵူၼ် တႆး ႁၵ်ႉ လွင်ႈ သုၶ ၵတ်းယဵၼ် ၼပ်ႉယမ် သြႃႇ ၸဝ်ႈ တြႃး ပုတ်ႉထ
sentences.surface_assamese: টাই প্ৰজাসকলে শান্তি, সম্প্ৰীতি আৰু বুদ্ধৰ অহিংসা নীতিৰ প্ৰতি অপৰিসীম শ্ৰদ্ধা ৰাখিছিল
sentences.romanization: kon tai hak lɔ́ŋ su-kha kat-yen nap-yam saa-raa tsao traa put-tha
sentences.translation_en: The Tai people cherished peace and harmony, holding deep reverence for the venerable Sangha and the teachings of the Buddha.
sentences.translation_as: টাই প্ৰজাসকলে শান্তি, সম্প্ৰীতি আৰু বুদ্ধৰ অহিংসা নীতিৰ প্ৰতি অপৰিসীম শ্ৰদ্ধা ৰাখিছিল।
sentences.notes: Imperial Gazetteer (1908: 108). Social harmony and religious life in the Tai states.

sentences.lik_tai: ၼႃင်ႇ ၼႇ ၶႃၼ်ႊ ေꩢင်ႊ တပ် လမ်ႇ ၵိႈ ေၵႈ
sentences.assamese_script: নাঙ² ন² খান⁶ সেঙ⁶ তপ্‌¹ লাম² কি³ কে³
sentences.translation: Then the good lady answered in response to him.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Then the good lady answered in response to him.
sentences.notes: * kqi3 kj3 was translated as 'begin to answer'.Ngi Kheng did not give an analysis for the phrase kojek. It may be based on Shan WkH 'untie, find a solution'.

sentences.text_roman: tsem2 kaa1 paan2 n2 ik1 tsuu5 nai4
sentences.lik_tai: ေၸမ်ႇ ၵႃ ပႃၼ်ႇ ၼႇ ဢိၵ် ၸႉ ၼႆး
sentences.assamese_script: চেম² কা¹ পান² ন² ইক্‌¹ চ⁵ নাই⁴
sentences.translation: From the past time, from the present time,
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: From the past time, from the present time,

sentences.text_roman: khat1 tsuu5 hvng6 hii2
sentences.lik_tai: ၶတ် ၸႉ ႁင်ႊ ႁႇ
sentences.assamese_script: খাত্‌¹ চ⁵ হঙ⁶ হ²
sentences.translation: From the time long, long ago,
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: From the time long, long ago,
sentences.notes: Chaichuen Khamdaengyodthai stated that this was xtq:xjH 'search, trace, from this day to the present' in Shan, from xtq: 'press apart' and xjH 'follow closely'.

sentences.text_roman: han4 kaa1 naa3 tak1 maa2
sentences.lik_tai: ႁၼ်း ၵႃ ၼႃႈ တၵ် မႃႇ
sentences.assamese_script: হান⁴ কা¹ না³ তাক্‌¹ মা²
sentences.translation: From then on until the future.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: From then on until the future.

sentences.text_roman: naang2 mau1 laa1 saa1 mk1 khun2 ngin2
sentences.lik_tai: ၼႃင်ႇ မဝ် လႃ ꩢႃ မၵ် ၶုၼ်ႇ ငိၼ်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: নাঙ² মাও¹ লা¹ সা¹ মক্‌¹ খুন² ঙিন²
sentences.translation: Then he went up to her and asked her name. She said 'My name is that which neither is, nor was, nor ever shall be.' 'Madam, there is nothing in the world immortal, and your name must be Amar¿, the Immortal.' 'Even so, master.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Then he went up to her and asked her name. She said 'My name is that which neither is, nor was, nor ever shall be.' 'Madam, there is nothing in the world immortal, and your name must be Amar¿, the Immortal.' 'Even so, master.
sentences.notes: Cowell (1990:182) gives the following translation of this whole passage:

sentences.text_roman: saing6 naau2 kham2 k4 huu4 yaam2 neu2 kh3 sv5
sentences.lik_tai: ꩢႆင်ႊ ၼႃဝ်ႇ ၶမ်ႇ ၵး ႁး ယႃမ်ႇ ၼိုႇ ၶႈ ꩢႉ
sentences.assamese_script: সাইঙ⁶ নাও² খাম² ক⁴ হ⁴ যাম² নু² খ³ স⁵
sentences.translation: The golden diamond star knew the correct meaning of her words.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The golden diamond star knew the correct meaning of her words.

sentences.text_roman: kaa5 tsv5 lum5 l1 pzng1 kon2
sentences.lik_tai: ၵႃႉ ၸႉ လုမ်ႉ လ ပင် ၵူၼ်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: কা⁵ চ⁵ লুম⁵ ল¹ পঙ¹ কোন²
sentences.translation: Among all things, among the law of nature and humans,
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Among all things, among the law of nature and humans,

sentences.text_roman: phav6 yang6 wj5 taang2 pzng2 hv6
sentences.lik_tai: ၽႊ ယင်ႊ ဝႉ တႃင်ႇ ပင်ႇ ႁႊ
sentences.assamese_script: ফ⁶ যাঙ⁶ ৱ⁵ তাঙ² পঙ² হ⁶
sentences.translation: There is no way for anybody to avoid death.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: There is no way for anybody to avoid death.
sentences.notes: *When a verb is to be nominalised, the word tgq (tAN2 'way')is prefixed.

sentences.text_roman: svng6 nan4 saai6 hung5 hik4 tsv5 am1 phuu3 saa5
sentences.lik_tai: ꩢင်ႊ ၼၼ်း ꩢႃႆႊ ႁုင်ႉ ႁိၵ်း ၸႉ ဢမ် ၽႈ ꩢႃႉ
sentences.assamese_script: সঙ⁶ নান⁴ সাই⁶ হুঙ⁵ হিক্‌⁴ চ⁵ অম¹ ফ³ সা⁵
sentences.translation: Like that he of the bright lineage called her the famous lady Ampala.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Like that he of the bright lineage called her the famous lady Ampala.

sentences.text_roman: naang2 nii2 z2 kam2 mauk1 kaa5 sv5
sentences.lik_tai: ၼႃင်ႇ ၼႇ ဢႇ ၵမ်ႇ မဝ်ၵ် ၵႃႉ ꩢႉ
sentences.assamese_script: নাঙ² ন² অ² কাম² মাওক্‌¹ কা⁵ স⁵
sentences.translation: That good lady spoke clearly and at once.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: That good lady spoke clearly and at once.
sentences.notes: * AJwqkM z2 kam2  means 'to answer "Yes"'. Here z2 is behaving like a verb.

sentences.text_roman: tsav2 hung5 phaa4 ma1 laai2 thaam6
sentences.assamese_script: চ² হুঙ⁵ ফা⁴ মা¹ লাই² থাম⁶
sentences.translation: The bright mind, our Lord Mahosatha, asked her (again):
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The bright mind, our Lord Mahosatha, asked her (again):

sentences.text_roman: t5 tsi4 tak1 phaai3 kaa1 naa3 tsm2 phav6
sentences.lik_tai: တႉ ၸိး တၵ် ၽႃႆႈ ၵႃ ၼႃႈ ၸမ်ႇ ၽႊ
sentences.assamese_script: ত⁵ চি⁴ তাক্‌¹ ফাই³ কা¹ না³ চম² ফ⁶
sentences.translation: Now, Oh lady, who are following?
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Now, Oh lady, who are following?

sentences.text_roman: pzng2 nav6 mauk1 khun6 ngin2 hav3 tsaing5 nuu2 lj4
sentences.lik_tai: ပင်ႇ ၼႊ မဝ်ၵ် ၶုၼ်ႊ ငိၼ်ႇ ႁႈ ၸႆင်ႉ ၼႇ လး
sentences.assamese_script: পঙ² ন⁶ মাওক্‌¹ খুন⁶ ঙিন² হ³ চাইঙ⁵ ন² ল⁴
sentences.translation: Tell me so that I may clearly know.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Tell me so that I may clearly know.
sentences.notes: Chaichuen stated that mokqnUel mauk1 nU2 lj4 should be translated as  'please tell me.'

sentences.text_roman: naang2 k4 khe2 seng6 tp1 khaam2 tsau3
sentences.lik_tai: ၼႃင်ႇ ၵး ေၶႇ ေꩢင်ႊ တပ် ၶႃမ်ႇ ၸဝ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: নাঙ² ক⁴ খে² সেঙ⁶ তপ্‌¹ খাম² চাও³
sentences.translation: The lady pleasantly answered the Lord's words.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The lady pleasantly answered the Lord's words.

sentences.text_roman: tsi4 tak1 phaai3 song1 khau3 phii6 hzn2 tj4 yau4
sentences.lik_tai: ၸိး တၵ် ၽႃႆႈ ꩢူင် ၶဝ်ႈ ၽႊ ႁၼ်ႇ တး ယဝ်း
sentences.assamese_script: চি⁴ তাক্‌¹ ফাই³ সোঙ¹ খাও³ ফ⁶ হন² ত⁴ যাও⁴
sentences.translation: I am taking food to the house spirits.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: I am taking food to the house spirits.

sentences.text_roman: yt4 khai1 paak1 waa5 khaan6 kam2
sentences.lik_tai: ယတ်း ၶႆ ပႃၵ် ဝႃႉ ၶႃၼ်ႊ ၵမ်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: যত্‌⁴ খাই¹ পাক্‌¹ ৱা⁵ খান⁶ কাম²
sentences.translation: The Lord, the Egg of the Sky, spoke further.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The Lord, the Egg of the Sky, spoke further.

sentences.text_roman: svng6 nan4 hi2 pai2 tsm2 tsau3 laa2
sentences.lik_tai: ꩢင်ႊ ၼၼ်း ႁိႇ ပႆႇ ၸမ်ႇ ၸဝ်ႈ လႃႇ
sentences.assamese_script: সঙ⁶ নান⁴ হি² পাই² চম² চাও³ লা²
sentences.translation: She was, nevertheless, going to follow her father.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: She was, nevertheless, going to follow her father.

sentences.text_roman: t5 laa2 phaai3 pai2 nav6 taang1 tii5
sentences.lik_tai: တႉ လႃႇ ၽႃႆႈ ပႆႇ ၼႊ တႃင် တႉ
sentences.assamese_script: ত⁵ লা² ফাই³ পাই² ন⁶ তাঙ¹ ত⁵
sentences.translation: Now your parent has gone to what other place.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Now your parent has gone to what other place.

sentences.text_roman: p2 yaap1 tsav2 tsi4 sii1
sentences.lik_tai: ပႇ ယႃပ် ၸႇ ၸိး ꩢ
sentences.assamese_script: প² যাপ্‌¹ চ² চি⁴ স¹
sentences.translation: The mind of this young lady was difficult to overcome.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The mind of this young lady was difficult to overcome.
sentences.notes: * Chaichuen stated that this was literally 'prepare-gold', and refers to the one who prepares gold for you, i.e. parent. It usually means 'mother'.

sentences.text_roman: nvng1 nai4 si1 phaa4 laung2 tsjt4 sau2 thaam6
sentences.lik_tai: ၼင် ၼႆး ꩢိ ၽႃး လဝ်င်ႇ ၸတ်း ꩢဝ်ႇ ထႃမ်ႊ
sentences.assamese_script: নঙ¹ নাই⁴ সি¹ ফা⁴ লাওঙ² চত্‌⁴ সাও² থাম⁶
sentences.translation: Then the great Lord, the Bodhisattva stopped to ask her.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Then the great Lord, the Bodhisattva stopped to ask her.

sentences.text_roman: seng6 waan6 naang2 ngaam2 taan3 khe2 mauk1 tsau3
sentences.lik_tai: ေꩢင်ႊ ဝႃၼ်ႊ ၼႃင်ႇ ငႃမ်ႇ တႃၼ်ႈ ေၶႇ မဝ်ၵ် ၸဝ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: সেঙ⁶ ৱান⁶ নাঙ² ঙাম² তান³ খে² মাওক্‌¹ চাও³
sentences.translation: The beautiful lady spoke agreeable and sweet words to the Lord.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The beautiful lady spoke agreeable and sweet words to the Lord.
sentences.notes: * Chaichuen stated that this was sojH 'inflorescence' and referred to Nang Pingya.

sentences.text_roman: pz5 saung6 an2 tv2 an2 nvng5
sentences.lik_tai: ပႉ ꩢဝ်င်ႊ ဢၼ်ႇ တႇ ဢၼ်ႇ ၼင်ႉ
sentences.assamese_script: প⁵ সাওঙ⁶ অন² ত² অন² নঙ⁵
sentences.translation: And so two are used as one.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: And so two are used as one.

sentences.text_roman: p5 uu3 pai2 suu1 mzng2 yang2 maa2 waa5 nai4
sentences.lik_tai: ပႉ ဢႈ ပႆႇ ꩢ မင်ႇ ယင်ႇ မႃႇ ဝႃႉ ၼႆး
sentences.assamese_script: প⁵ অ³ পাই² স¹ মঙ² যাঙ² মা² ৱা⁵ নাই⁴
sentences.translation: Her father went into the country to do so, it is said.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Her father went into the country to do so, it is said.

sentences.text_roman: n1 phaa4 khat1 khi3 thoi3 tsav2 n1 aam2 nam6
sentences.lik_tai: ၼ ၽႃး ၶတ် ၶိႈ ထူႆႈ ၸႇ ၼ ဢႃမ်ႇ ၼမ်ႊ
sentences.assamese_script: ন¹ ফা⁴ খাত্‌¹ খি³ থওই³ চ² ন¹ আম² নাম⁶
sentences.translation: The shoot of the sky, much surprised, breathed with short breaths.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The shoot of the sky, much surprised, breathed with short breaths.
sentences.notes: * enafa nq1 phA4 refers to Chaw Mahosatha.

sentences.text_roman: kham2 naing2 tp1 saai6 hung5 kuu5 tsaung4
sentences.lik_tai: ၶမ်ႇ ၼႆင်ႇ တပ် ꩢႃႆႊ ႁုင်ႉ ၵႉ ၸဝ်င်း
sentences.assamese_script: খাম² নাইঙ² তপ্‌¹ সাই⁶ হুঙ⁵ ক⁵ চাওঙ⁴
sentences.translation: The red golden bright thread replied to every question.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The red golden bright thread replied to every question.
sentences.notes: sjhugq sAi6 huN5 refers to Nang Ampala.

sentences.text_roman: hi2 laa2 phaai3 phz6 naa2 khuu5 yaap1
sentences.assamese_script: হি² লা² ফাই³ ফ⁶ না² খ⁵ যাপ্‌¹
sentences.translation: But (he knew) that her father was raking the field and doing the hard work of preparing for cultivation.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: But (he knew) that her father was raking the field and doing the hard work of preparing for cultivation.
sentences.notes: Chaichuen explained that raking is the process which follows ploughing.

sentences.text_roman: hi2 p5 khaai2 kap1 phz6 naa2 k4 yau4
sentences.lik_tai: ႁိႇ ပႉ ၶႃႆႇ ၵပ် ၽႊ ၼႃႇ ၵး ယဝ်း
sentences.assamese_script: হি² প⁵ খাই² কাপ্‌¹ ফ⁶ না² ক⁴ যাও⁴
sentences.translation: Hoi!, (two) male buffaloes were yoked in order to rake the field.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Hoi!, (two) male buffaloes were yoked in order to rake the field.
sentences.notes: * Chaichuen stated that these are the words used to speak to the buffaloes - xoMsgqxj khAm2 saN1 khAi2.

sentences.text_roman: tii5 kaang3 pon4 naa2 khum4 heng2 nav6
sentences.lik_tai: တႉ ၵႃင်ႈ ပူၼ်း ၼႃႇ ၶုမ်း ေႁင်ႇ ၼႊ
sentences.assamese_script: ত⁵ কাঙ³ পোন⁴ না² খুম⁴ হেঙ² ন⁶
sentences.translation: In which wide field yonder (is he)?
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: In which wide field yonder (is he)?

sentences.text_roman: ii1 mav2 naang2 phaai3 ki2 t1 tsm2 p5 nan4 naa4
sentences.lik_tai: ဢ မႇ ၼႃင်ႇ ၽႃႆႈ ၵိႇ တ ၸမ်ႇ ပႉ ၼၼ်း ၼႃး
sentences.assamese_script: অ¹ ম² নাঙ² ফাই³ কি² ত¹ চম² প⁵ নান⁴ না⁴
sentences.translation: I pity you, lady, for having to walk and follow your father.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: I pity you, lady, for having to walk and follow your father.

sentences.text_roman: saai6 hung5 nj4 kam2 tp1 maang2 ki4 taan3
sentences.lik_tai: ꩢႃႆႊ ႁုင်ႉ ၼး ၵမ်ႇ တပ် မႃင်ႇ ၵိး တႃၼ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: সাই⁶ হুঙ⁵ ন⁴ কাম² তপ্‌¹ মাঙ² কি⁴ তান³
sentences.translation: The bright line, that Ampala, responded to the words of the Bodhisattva
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The bright line, that Ampala, responded to the words of the Bodhisattva

sentences.text_roman: mii2 kav3 maan3 kaa1 yau4 mau1 hzn2
sentences.lik_tai: မႇ ၵႈ မႃၼ်ႈ ၵႃ ယဝ်း မဝ် ႁၼ်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: ম² ক³ মান³ কা¹ যাও⁴ মাও¹ হন²
sentences.translation: There is a village, nearby, with no houses.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: There is a village, nearby, with no houses.

sentences.text_roman: n1 tsi4 waa5 nvng1 nan4 pen2 kam2
sentences.lik_tai: ၼ ၸိး ဝႃႉ ၼင် ၼၼ်း ေပၼ်ႇ ၵမ်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: ন¹ চি⁴ ৱা⁵ নঙ¹ নান⁴ পেন² কাম²
sentences.translation: This lady said into words.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: This lady said into words.

sentences.text_roman: lamlam tsav2 sjn3 n1 a1 tsaing5 sing3
sentences.lik_tai: လမ် ၸႇ ꩢၼ်ႈ ၼ ဢႃ ၸႆင်ႉ ꩢိင်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: লম¹ চ² সন³ ন¹ অ¹ চাইঙ⁵ সিঙ³
sentences.translation: And the beautiful hearted shoot, the Bodhisattva who knows all,
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: And the beautiful hearted shoot, the Bodhisattva who knows all,

sentences.text_roman: svng6 nan4 naa2 peng2 kav3 ngn2 nin2 paa1
sentences.lik_tai: ꩢင်ႊ ၼၼ်း ၼႃႇ ေပင်ႇ ၵႈ ငၼ်ႇ ၼိၼ်ႇ ပႃ
sentences.assamese_script: সঙ⁶ নান⁴ না² পেঙ² ক³ ঙন² নিন² পা¹
sentences.translation: That this level field was nearby to a cemetery.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: That this level field was nearby to a cemetery.

sentences.text_roman: mz5 nai4 p5 pai2 thzn1 pheu3 yau4
sentences.lik_tai: မႉ ၼႆး ပႉ ပႆႇ ထၼ် ၽိုႈ ယဝ်း
sentences.assamese_script: ম⁵ নাই⁴ প⁵ পাই² থন¹ ফু³ যাও⁴
sentences.translation: At the time when her father has finished clearing the forest, he will return.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: At the time when her father has finished clearing the forest, he will return.

sentences.text_roman: naang2 n1 tsi4 nj6 kam2
sentences.lik_tai: ၼႃင်ႇ ၼ ၸိး ၼႊ ၵမ်ႇ

It offers an in-depth analysis of the non-Aryan Tibeto-Burman and Tai-Kadai substrate in Eastern Indic phonology, notably investigating the unrounded vowels and tonal influences resulting from centuries of intimate Tai-Assamese bilingualism.

notes: Masterly treatise on the literary history, paleography, and cultural significance of the Tai script by eminent historian Prof. Sai Aung Tun. The volume traces the evolution of Lik Tai from Brahmic antecedents into the palm-leaf, folded bark, and modern printed books across Shanland, Yunnan, and Assam.

title: Chronicle from Ancestor Chaw Tai Lung up to King Sukapha
title_tai: Lik4 Pvn1 Chaw3 Tai1 Lung1 Thung1 Su5 Kaa3 Phaa3
author: Dibya Shyam & Nora Lineage Keepers

sentences.text_roman: chaw3 tai1 lung1 pen1 pu5 yaa3 khɯa1 tai1
sentences.lik_tai: သဝ်ႈ တႆ လုင် ေပၼ် ပုႉ ယႃႈ ၶိုဝ်ႃ တႆ

sentences.free_translation_as: চৌ তाई লুং আছিল আমাৰ স্বৰ্গীয় পূৰ্বপুৰুষ যাৰ পৰা সুবিশাল তाई বংশৰ সূচনা হৈছিল।
sentences.speaker: Dibya Shyam & Nora Lineage Keepers
sentences.notes: Authentic passage from Chronicle from Ancestor Chaw Tai Lung up to King Sukapha

sentences.text_roman: khaw1 tang3 mung1 rim1 nam6 mau1 nam6 jin1
sentences.lik_tai: ၶဝ် တင်ႈ မုင် ရိမ် ၼမ်ႊ မဝ် ၼမ်ႊ ဢၼ်
sentences.assamese_script: খাৱ¹ তাঙ³ মুঙ¹ ৰিম¹ নাম⁶ মাও¹ নাম⁶ অন¹
sentences.free_translation_en: They founded mighty realms along the fertile Shweli (Nam Mau) before migrating toward the Patkai.
sentences.free_translation_as: তেওঁলোকে মাও নদীৰ পাৰত সুবিখ্যাত ৰাজ্য স্থাপন কৰি পৰৱৰ্তী সময়ত পাতকাইৰ ফালে অগ্ৰসৰ হৈছিল।
sentences.speaker: Dibya Shyam & Nora Lineage Keepers
sentences.notes: Authentic passage from Chronicle from Ancestor Chaw Tai Lung up to King Sukapha

sentences.text_roman: tsaw3 lung1 su5 kaa3 phaa3 long1 maa1 luk4 mung1 mau1
sentences.lik_tai: ၸဝ်ႈ လုင် ꩢုႉ ၵႃႈ ၽႃႈ လူင် မႃ လုၵ်း မုင် မဝ်
sentences.assamese_script: চাৱ³ লুঙ¹ সু⁵ কা³ ফা³ লোঙ¹ মা¹ লুক্‌⁴ মুঙ¹ মাও¹
sentences.free_translation_en: In 1228 AD, Prince Chau Lung Sukapha led his followers across the Patkai into the plains of Upper Assam.
sentences.free_translation_as: ১২২৮ খ্ৰীষ্টাব্দত ৰাজকুমাৰ চৌলুং চুকাফাই পাতকাই পাহাৰ পাৰ হৈ উজনি অসমৰ ব্ৰহ্মপুত্ৰ উপত্যকাত প্ৰৱেশ কৰিছিল।
sentences.speaker: Dibya Shyam & Nora Lineage Keepers
sentences.notes: Authentic passage from Chronicle from Ancestor Chaw Tai Lung up to King Sukapha

sentences.text_roman: khon1 nora1 kap4 khon1 a1 hom1 pen1 phi5 nong4
sentences.lik_tai: ၶူၼ် ၼ ၵပ်း ၶူၼ် ဢႃ ႁူမ် ေပၼ် ၽိႉ ၼူင်း
sentences.assamese_script: খোন¹ ন¹ কাপ্‌⁴ খোন¹ অ¹ হোম¹ পেন¹ ফি⁵ নোঙ⁴
sentences.free_translation_en: The Nora (Khamyang) and the Ahoms lived as elder and younger brothers under one ancestral bond.
sentences.free_translation_as: নোৰা (খাময়াং) আৰু আহোমসকল একে তেজ আৰু পূৰ্বপুৰুষৰ বংশধৰ হিচাপে ককাই-ভাইৰ সম্পৰ্কেৰে বান্ধ খাই আছিল।
sentences.speaker: Dibya Shyam & Nora Lineage Keepers
sentences.notes: Authentic passage from Chronicle from Ancestor Chaw Tai Lung up to King Sukapha

sentences.text_roman: pvn1 mung1 nai6 thɯ1 pen1 lak4 man3 khong1 kun1 haw1
sentences.lik_tai: ပၼ် မုင် ၼႆႊ ထို ေပၼ် လၵ်း မၼ်ႈ ၶူင် ၵုၼ် ႁဝ်
sentences.assamese_script: পন¹ মুঙ¹ নাই⁶ থু¹ পেন¹ লাক্‌⁴ মান³ খোঙ¹ কুন¹ হাৱ¹
sentences.free_translation_en: This ancestral Buranji chronicle is preserved as an everlasting beacon of Tai history and courage.
sentences.free_translation_as: এই প্ৰাচীন বুৰঞ্জী পুথিখনে তाई জাতিৰ গৌৰৱময় ইতিহাস আৰু অদম্য সাহসৰ চিৰন্তন স্বাক্ষৰ বহন কৰি আহিছে।
sentences.speaker: Dibya Shyam & Nora Lineage Keepers
sentences.notes: Authentic passage from Chronicle from Ancestor Chaw Tai Lung up to King Sukapha

notes: Historical chronicle manuscript documented in Pacific Linguistics 565 (p. 410), recording the royal lineage of the Tai people from celestial ancestor Chaw Tai Lung across Upper Burma through the 13th-century Patkai crossing of Prince Sukapha into the Brahmaputra valley.

title: Tai Khamyang Buranji: Historical Chronicle and Clan Genealogy of the Tai Khamyang Community
author: Tai Khamyang Buranji Pranayan Samiti (Sri Chaimet Bailung & Sri Aongching Shyam)

sentences.lik_tai: ပိုၼ်းတဲးၶမ်းယၢင် ပဵၼ် ပိုၼ်း ၵဝ်ႇၵႄႇ ၶွင် ပီႈၼွင်ႉ တဲး

sentences.free_translation_en: The Tai Khamyang Buranji is an ancient historical chronicle of the Tai brethren.
sentences.free_translation_as: ত্তাই খাময়াং বুৰঞ্জী হৈছে টাই ভাতৃসকলৰ এক প্ৰাচীন বুৰঞ্জী।
sentences.speaker: Sri Chaimet Bailung

sentences.lik_tai: ဝႆႈသႃ ပူႇလိၼ် ပူႇထဝ်ႈ ယႃႈလိၼ် ယႃႈထဝ်ႈ ၵူႈ ၵေႃႉ

sentences.free_translation_en: We pay humble homage to all our ancestral grandfathers and grandmothers (Pu-Lin Pu-Thao, Ya-Lin Ya-Thao).
sentences.free_translation_as: সেই সকল পথিকৃত পু-লিন-পু-থাও, জ্যালিন্‌-জ্যাথাওলৈ আমাৰ সশ্ৰদ্ধ প্ৰণাম যাচিছো।
sentences.speaker: Tai Khamyang Buranji Editorial Committee

sentences.text_roman: kham yang luk möng mao lam kham loy pat kai ma

sentences.free_translation_en: The Khamyang people originated from Mong Mao and crossed the rugged Patkai ranges into Assam.
sentences.free_translation_as: খাময়াংসকল পূৰ্বে মং মাওৰ পৰা আহি পাটকাই পৰ্ব্বত অতিক্ৰমি অসমত প্ৰৱেশ কৰিছিল।
sentences.speaker: Sri Aongching Shyam

sentences.free_translation_en: The clans of Thaumung, Chowhai, Chowlu, and Shyam achieved high renown among the Khamyang.
sentences.free_translation_as: থাওমুং, চাওহাই, চাউলু আৰু শ্যাম বংশই খাময়াংসকলৰ মাজত বিশেষ মৰ্যাদা লাভ কৰিছিল।
sentences.speaker: Sri Chaimet Bailung
