notes: Authoritative anthropological study by Dr. B.J. Terwiel documenting the historical migrations, kinship systems, life-cycle ceremonies, and soul-calling (*hɔŋ khon*) rituals of the Tai Khamyang, Phake, and Khamti in Assam.

title: The Book of the Twelve Philosophical Questions
title_tai: Lik4 Thaa3 Kham1 Thaam1 Sip4 Song1 Kho3
author: Sa Cham Phukan

sentences.text_roman: pa1 sip1 sng1 tsng2 nai3
sentences.lik_tai: ပႃ ꩢိပ် ꩢင် ၸင်ႇ ၼႆႈ
sentences.assamese_script: পা¹ সিপ্‌¹ সঙ¹ চঙ² নাই³
sentences.translation: I mean ...
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: I mean ...
sentences.notes: The very beginning of the first syllable was omitted on the taped version.

sentences.text_roman: khun1 mɯng2 baa1
sentences.lik_tai: ၶုၼ် မိုင်ႇ ဢ
sentences.assamese_script: খুন¹ মুঙ² অ¹
sentences.translation: The King of the country of Varanasi...
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The King of the country of Varanasi...

sentences.text_roman: naang2 dj1 pa1 dj1
sentences.lik_tai: ၼႃင်ႇ ဢ ပႃ ဢ
sentences.assamese_script: নাঙ² অ¹ পা¹ অ¹
sentences.translation: The queen was Patuma.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The queen was Patuma.
sentences.notes: * Pali word for lotus, paduma 'the lotus Nelumbium speciosum'. There seems to be a regular process in Tai of adding a final -N in Pali loan words, possibly conditioned by the following syllable which has a nasal initial.

sentences.text_roman: phii1 tsik1 tsng3 nai3 maa2 nj1 maa2 tak3 wai3
sentences.lik_tai: ၽ ၸိၵ် ၸင်ႈ ၼႆႈ မႃႇ ၼ မႃႇ တၵ်ႈ ဝႆႈ
sentences.assamese_script: ফ¹ চিক্‌¹ চঙ³ নাই³ মা² ন¹ মা² তাক্‌³ ৱাই³
sentences.translation: The goddess from the highest peak of the palace came to ask the twelve questions.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The goddess from the highest peak of the palace came to ask the twelve questions.
sentences.notes: This refers to a dream of Queen Patuma Devi.

sentences.text_roman: paa1 sip1 tsng3 kai3
sentences.lik_tai: ပႃ ꩢိပ် ၸင်ႈ ၵႆႈ
sentences.assamese_script: পা¹ সিপ্‌¹ চঙ³ কাই³
sentences.translation: The twelve questions, as soon as possible.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The twelve questions, as soon as possible.
sentences.notes: * given by Nabin as 'as soon as possible'

sentences.text_roman: naang2 dj1 j1 tɯn1 maa2
sentences.lik_tai: ၼႃင်ႇ ဢ ဢ တိုၼ် မႃႇ
sentences.assamese_script: নাঙ² অ¹ অ¹ তুন¹ মা²
sentences.translation: Queen Devi woke up.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Queen Devi woke up.
sentences.notes: *When translating this, Nabin Shyam wrote nai3 'this'

sentences.text_roman: baa3 maa2 tng2 khaɯ3 dai3
sentences.lik_tai: ဢႈ မႃႇ တင်ႇ ၶႈ ဢႈ
sentences.assamese_script: অ³ মা² তঙ² খ³ অ³
sentences.translation: She was crazy and wanted to know (the answer to the questions).
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: She was crazy and wanted to know (the answer to the questions).

sentences.text_roman: aa1 man2 aa1 kun2 wun1 man2 kau3 mun1 yang2
sentences.lik_tai: ဢႃ မၼ်ႇ ဢႃ ၵုၼ်ႇ ဝုၼ် မၼ်ႇ ၵဝ်ႈ မုၼ် ယင်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: আ¹ মান² আ¹ কুন² ৱুন¹ মান² কাও³ মুন¹ যাঙ²
sentences.translation: (The King) had ministers and 90,000 soldiers.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: (The King) had ministers and 90,000 soldiers.

sentences.text_roman: hng3 hang2 khau1 tang1 kau3 mun1 nai3
sentences.lik_tai: ႁင်ႈ ႁင်ႇ ၶဝ် တင် ၵဝ်ႈ မုၼ် ၼႆႈ
sentences.assamese_script: হঙ³ হাঙ² খাও¹ তাঙ¹ কাও³ মুন¹ নাই³
sentences.translation: (She) called to the ninety thousand (soldiers)
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: (She) called to the ninety thousand (soldiers)

sentences.text_roman: suu1 wan2 m1 hang2 kau2 ta1 dai3 kj3 paa1
sentences.lik_tai: ꩢ ဝၼ်ႇ မ ႁင်ႇ ၵဝ်ႇ တႃ ဢႈ ၵႈ ပႃ
sentences.assamese_script: স¹ ৱান² ম¹ হাঙ² কাও² তা¹ অ³ ক³ পা¹
sentences.translation: Today you must find the answer to these twelve questions.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Today you must find the answer to these twelve questions.

sentences.text_roman: p2 ma1 kj3 nai3 dai3 daap1 tsau3 saa1
sentences.lik_tai: ပႇ မႃ ၵႈ ၼႆႈ ဢႈ ဢပ် ၸဝ်ႈ ꩢႃ
sentences.assamese_script: প² মা¹ ক³ নাই³ অ³ অপ্‌¹ চাও³ সা¹
sentences.translation: Queen Devi asked all the soldiers ...
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Queen Devi asked all the soldiers ...
sentences.notes: When translating this, Nabin read it as suu1 dai3 daap1 cau3 saa1 and explained this as follows:

sentences.text_roman: pung2 taai2
sentences.assamese_script: পুঙ² তাই²
sentences.translation: You will be ordered to die.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: You will be ordered to die.

sentences.text_roman: aa1 sip1 kau3 mun1 nai3 aa3 paak1 saa1
sentences.lik_tai: ဢႃ ꩢိပ် ၵဝ်ႈ မုၼ် ၼႆႈ ဢႃႈ ပႃၵ် ꩢႃ
sentences.assamese_script: আ¹ সিপ্‌¹ কাও³ মুন¹ নাই³ আ³ পাক্‌¹ সা¹
sentences.translation: The 90000 ministers were surprised.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The 90000 ministers were surprised.

sentences.text_roman: phaɯ1 k3 ma1 t ɯng1 tng2
sentences.lik_tai: ၽ ၵႈ မႃ တ ဢိုင် တင်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: ফ¹ ক³ মা¹ ত¹ উঙ¹ তঙ²
sentences.translation: Nobody could understand.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Nobody could understand.

sentences.text_roman: lai3 tsau3 khun1 nj3
sentences.lik_tai: လႆႈ ၸဝ်ႈ ၶုၼ် ၼႈ
sentences.assamese_script: লাই³ চাও³ খুন¹ ন³
sentences.translation: The king felt pity for the 90000 ministers (and soldiers).
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The king felt pity for the 90000 ministers (and soldiers).

sentences.text_roman: naang2 ɯi1 khau1 nai3 haɯ3 khaa1 au2 saam1 pii2
sentences.lik_tai: ၼႃင်ႇ ဢိုႆ ၶဝ် ၼႆႈ ႁႈ ၶႃ ဢဝ်ႇ ꩢႃမ် ပႇ
sentences.assamese_script: নাঙ² অুই¹ খাও¹ নাই³ হ³ খা¹ ঔ² সাম¹ প²
sentences.translation: The King said to Nang Devi
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The King said to Nang Devi

sentences.text_roman: saam1 pii2 haɯ3 khau1 au2
sentences.lik_tai: ꩢႃမ် ပႇ ႁႈ ၶဝ် ဢဝ်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: সাম¹ প² হ³ খাও¹ ঔ²
sentences.translation: Let them have three years.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Let them have three years.

sentences.text_roman: naang2 dj1 nai3 waa2
sentences.lik_tai: ၼႃင်ႇ ဢ ၼႆႈ ဝႃႇ
sentences.assamese_script: নাঙ² অ¹ নাই³ ৱা²
sentences.translation: Nang Devi said:
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Nang Devi said:
sentences.notes: Nabin Shyam stated that the word waa2 'say' should have been present at the end of the line.

sentences.text_roman: kau2 ɯm1 pj3 haɯ3 saam1 pii2
sentences.lik_tai: ၵဝ်ႇ ဢိုမ် ပႈ ႁႈ ꩢႃမ် ပႇ
sentences.assamese_script: কাও² উম¹ প³ হ³ সাম¹ প²
sentences.translation: I cannot give them three years.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: I cannot give them three years.

sentences.text_roman: kau2 ta1 taai2 yau3 kau2 p2 ma1 dai3
sentences.lik_tai: ၵဝ်ႇ တႃ တႃႆႇ ယဝ်ႈ ၵဝ်ႇ ပႇ မႃ ဢႈ
sentences.assamese_script: কাও² তা¹ তাই² যাও³ কাও² প² মা¹ অ³
sentences.translation: (By then) I will have died if I do not get to hear the answer.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: (By then) I will have died if I do not get to hear the answer.

sentences.text_roman: kau2 p2 ma1 dai3 nai3 kau2 ta1 taai2
sentences.lik_tai: ၵဝ်ႇ ပႇ မႃ ဢႈ ၼႆႈ ၵဝ်ႇ တႃ တႃႆႇ
sentences.assamese_script: কাও² প² মা¹ অ³ নাই³ কাও² তা¹ তাই²
sentences.translation: I will die if I do not get to hear the answer
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: I will die if I do not get to hear the answer

sentences.text_roman: lai3 tsau3 khun1 nai3 khɯn2
sentences.lik_tai: လႆႈ ၸဝ်ႈ ၶုၼ် ၼႆႈ ၶိုၼ်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: লাই³ চাও³ খুন¹ নাই³ খুন²
sentences.translation: Therefore, the king again asked her:
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Therefore, the king again asked her:

sentences.text_roman: ɯ2 saam1 dɯn2
sentences.lik_tai: ဢိုႇ ꩢႃမ် ဢၼ်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: উ² সাম¹ অন²
sentences.translation: (Can you give them) three months?
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: (Can you give them) three months?

sentences.text_roman: saam1 dɯn2 k3 kau2 ta1 taai2
sentences.lik_tai: ꩢႃမ် ဢၼ်ႇ ၵႈ ၵဝ်ႇ တႃ တႃႆႇ
sentences.assamese_script: সাম¹ অন² ক³ কাও² তা¹ তাই²
sentences.translation: In three months I will also die, if I don't get to hear (the answer).
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: In three months I will also die, if I don't get to hear (the answer).

sentences.text_roman: lai3 kau2 tsj2 m1 kau2 khaɯ3 dai3
sentences.lik_tai: လႆႈ ၵဝ်ႇ ၸႇ မ ၵဝ်ႇ ၶႈ ဢႈ
sentences.assamese_script: লাই³ কাও² চ² ম¹ কাও² খ³ অ³
sentences.translation: Therefore I want to hear (the answer) right now!
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Therefore I want to hear (the answer) right now!
sentences.notes: * The meaning of this morpheme is unclear. See also  HYPERLINK  \l "No11" example (11) above.

sentences.text_roman: mɯ2 tsau3 khun1
sentences.lik_tai: မိုႇ ၸဝ်ႈ ၶုၼ်
sentences.assamese_script: মু² চাও³ খুন¹
sentences.translation: So the king's face became ugly with sadness, pity.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: So the king's face became ugly with sadness, pity.

sentences.text_roman: naang2 dj1 nai3 kuu2 taai2
sentences.lik_tai: ၼႃင်ႇ ဢ ၼႆႈ ၵႇ တႃႆႇ
sentences.assamese_script: নাঙ² অ¹ নাই³ ক² তাই²
sentences.translation: Queen Devi was afraid to die.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ:  Queen Devi was afraid to die.

sentences.text_roman: naa3 man2 nai3 yung3 ka1 nai3 lau2
sentences.lik_tai: ၼႃႈ မၼ်ႇ ၼႆႈ ယုင်ႈ ၵႃ ၼႆႈ လဝ်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: না³ মান² নাই³ যুঙ³ কা¹ নাই³ লাও²
sentences.translation: His face was troubled, and after that he said:
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: His face was troubled, and after that he said:

sentences.text_roman: naang2 ɯi2 tsit1 wan2 haɯ3 khaa1 au2
sentences.lik_tai: ၼႃင်ႇ ဢိုႆႇ ၸိတ် ဝၼ်ႇ ႁႈ ၶႃ ဢဝ်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: নাঙ² অুই² চিত্‌¹ ৱান² হ³ খা¹ ঔ²
sentences.translation: My lady, give (them) seven days to search for (the answer).
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: My lady, give (them) seven days to search for (the answer).

sentences.text_roman: tsit1 wan2 nai3 khau1 pa1 dai3
sentences.lik_tai: ၸိတ် ဝၼ်ႇ ၼႆႈ ၶဝ် ပႃ ဢႈ
sentences.assamese_script: চিত্‌¹ ৱান² নাই³ খাও¹ পা¹ অ³
sentences.translation: If they have not got (the answer) in these seven days, let them be killed.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: If they have not got (the answer) in these seven days, let them be killed.
sentences.notes: The last three words are unclear on the tape. Nabin Shyam felt that they should be transcribed as given here.

sentences.text_roman: ɯ2 haɯ3 lj1 kau2 tsau3 ɯi2
sentences.lik_tai: ဢိုႇ ႁႈ လ ၵဝ်ႇ ၸဝ်ႈ ဢိုႆႇ
sentences.assamese_script: উ² হ³ ল¹ কাও² চাও³ অুই²
sentences.translation: Yes, my lord, I agree (to give them) seven days.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Yes, my lord, I agree (to give them) seven days.
sentences.notes: * Probably an error for cau3 kau2.

sentences.text_roman: p2 kaa1
sentences.lik_tai: ပႇ ၵႃ
sentences.assamese_script: প² কা¹
sentences.translation: It is enough.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: It is enough.

sentences.text_roman: mɯ2 thin1 kaa1
sentences.lik_tai: မိုႇ ထိၼ် ၵႃ
sentences.assamese_script: মু² থিন¹ কা¹
sentences.translation: Then (they) were sent out.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Then (they) were sent out.
sentences.notes: Sa Cham speaks very quickly at this point, and some words in (34) could not be made out.

sentences.text_roman: tsau3 khun1 lau2 pai2 khaa1 tsau3
sentences.lik_tai: ၸဝ်ႈ ၶုၼ် လဝ်ႇ ပႆႇ ၶႃ ၸဝ်ႈ
sentences.assamese_script: চাও³ খুন¹ লাও² পাই² খা¹ চাও³
sentences.translation: The king said: "Go forth and answer the questions and you shall be saved from death.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: The king said: "Go forth and answer the questions and you shall be saved from death.

sentences.text_roman: mɯ2 pai2 kuu2 naa2 kuu2 paa3
sentences.assamese_script: মু² পাই² ক² না² ক² পা³
sentences.translation: Then they went out in every direction.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Then they went out in every direction.

sentences.text_roman: pai2 pa1 k3 khaa1 ɯng1 dai3
sentences.lik_tai: ပႆႇ ပႃ ၵႈ ၶႃ ဢိုင် ဢႈ
sentences.assamese_script: পাই² পা¹ ক³ খা¹ উঙ¹ অ³
sentences.translation: On the next day they did not find (the answers).
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: On the next day they did not find (the answers).

sentences.text_roman: mɯng2 nai3 tang1 an2 tst1 kun2 kau3 mun1 nai1
sentences.lik_tai: မိုင်ႇ ၼႆႈ တင် ဢၼ်ႇ ၸတ် ၵုၼ်ႇ ၵဝ်ႈ မုၼ် ၼႆ
sentences.assamese_script: মুঙ² নাই³ তাঙ¹ অন² চত্‌¹ কুন² কাও³ মুন¹ নাই¹
sentences.translation: All over the country, those 90000 searched, and on the 2nd day, they also could not find (the answers)
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: All over the country, those 90000 searched, and on the 2nd day, they also could not find (the answers)

sentences.text_roman: thɯng1 maa2 haa3 wan2
sentences.lik_tai: ထိုင် မႃႇ ႁႃႈ ဝၼ်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: থুঙ¹ মা² হা³ ৱান²
sentences.translation: They reached the fifth day.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: They reached the fifth day.

sentences.text_roman: mɯ2 aa1 a1 phraa2 hau2
sentences.lik_tai: မိုႇ ဢႃ ဢႃ ၽႇ ႁဝ်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: মু² আ¹ অ¹ ফ² হাও²
sentences.translation: Then, the Bodhisatva, our Buddha ...
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Then, the Bodhisatva, our Buddha ...

sentences.text_roman: k1 aa1 tsuu2 tsaat3 k1 mɯ2
sentences.lik_tai: ၵ ဢႃ ၸႇ ၸႃတ်ႈ ၵ မိုႇ
sentences.assamese_script: ক¹ আ¹ চ² চাত্‌³ ক¹ মু²
sentences.translation: At that time he had taken birth as Gotama.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: At that time he had taken birth as Gotama.

sentences.text_roman: tsaat3 paan2 kn1 man2
sentences.lik_tai: ၸႃတ်ႈ ပႃၼ်ႇ ၵၼ် မၼ်ႇ
sentences.assamese_script: চাত্‌³ পান² কন¹ মান²
sentences.translation: In his previous life time his name was Canta sila.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: In his previous life time his name was Canta sila.

sentences.text_roman: luk3 a1
sentences.lik_tai: လုၵ်ႈ ဢႃ
sentences.assamese_script: লুক্‌³ অ¹
sentences.translation: From ...
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: From ...

sentences.text_roman: p2 man2 nai3 taai2 kaa1

title: The Story of the Two Brothers
author: Ee Nyan Khet

sentences.assamese_script: হোম⁵ কন² কা¹ ল¹ থন¹ ৱত্‌⁴

sentences.notes: When revising the text, Ee Nyan Khet stated that wJtq wzt4 should be omitted.

sentences.lik_tai: ၵႃ လ ထၼ် ယး

sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: They were in the forest, when the evening came.

sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Then an old man (came), carrying meat on his shoulder.

sentences.notes: When revising this translation, Ee Nyan Khet stated that (8) should be:

sentences.text_roman: puu1 nai4 ma1 hav3 wzt4
sentences.lik_tai: ပ ၼႆး မႃ ႁႈ ဝတ်း
sentences.assamese_script: প¹ নাই⁴ মা¹ হ³ ৱত্‌⁴

sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: (and so) the old man did not give (them the food).
sentences.notes: There is no negative tone on hav3 in (10), in contrast to (8).

sentences.text_roman: haa1 lop1 yj4 pii5 tsaai2 mvn2 waa5 wzt4
sentences.lik_tai: ႁႃ လူပ် ယး ပႉ ၸႃႆႇ မၼ်ႇ ဝႃႉ ဝတ်း

sentences.notes: In revising this text, Ee Nyan Khet suggested that the second line should read.

sentences.translation: We are so tired, hungry and thirsty", he spoke like that.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: We are so tired, hungry and thirsty", he spoke like that.
sentences.notes: The expression tauN4 mai3 'to be hungry.' literally means '(my) stomach is burning' and khq2 haiN3 'to be thirsty' literally means '(my) throat is dry.'

sentences.text_roman: mz5 nan4 puu1 nj4 nz4 mvn2 nj4
sentences.lik_tai: မႉ ၼၼ်း ပ ၼး ၼး မၼ်ႇ ၼး
sentences.assamese_script: ম⁵ নান⁴ প¹ ন⁴ ন⁴ মন² ন⁴

sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: So the old man gave his meat to those two brothers.

sentences.text_roman: nai3 kin2 kaa1 wzt4

sentences.assamese_script: নাই³ কিন² কা¹ ৱত্‌⁴
sentences.translation: Then (those two brothers) got to eat!
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: Then (those two brothers) got to eat!

sentences.text_roman: lai4 nai4 se6 khaam2 nj4 an2 waa5 nj4
sentences.lik_tai: လႆး ၼႆး ေꩢႊ ၶႃမ်ႇ ၼး ဢၼ်ႇ ဝႃႉ ၼး
sentences.assamese_script: লাই⁴ নাই⁴ সে⁶ খাম² ন⁴ অন² ৱা⁵ ন⁴
sentences.translation: That's why these words, it is said,
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: That's why these words, it is said,

sentences.text_roman: au2 kyaam2 yj4 hang2 pzn5 ma1 pj4 nvm1 waa5 nvng1 nai4
sentences.lik_tai: ဢဝ်ႇ ၵမ်ႇ ယး ႁင်ႇ ပၼ်ႉ မႃ ပး ၼမ် ဝႃႉ ၼင် ၼႆး
sentences.assamese_script: ঔ² কম² য⁴ হাঙ² পন⁵ মা¹ প⁴ নম¹ ৱা⁵ নঙ¹ নাই⁴

sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: If you are impolite, to others, you cannot succeed, it is said

sentences.text_roman: au2 on3 au2 waan6 yj4 pj4 hang2 pzn5 nvm1
sentences.lik_tai: ဢဝ်ႇ ဢူၼ်ႈ ဢဝ်ႇ ဝႃၼ်ႊ ယး ပး ႁင်ႇ ပၼ်ႉ ၼမ်
sentences.assamese_script: ঔ² ওন³ ঔ² ৱান⁶ য⁴ প⁴ হাঙ² পন⁵ নম¹
sentences.translation: If you speak softly and sweetly, you will succeed with others, it is said'.
sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: If you speak softly and sweetly, you will succeed with others, it is said'.

sentences.text_roman: sut1 yau4

sentences.assamese_script: সুত্‌¹ যাও⁴

sentences.translation_assamese: অসমীয়া অৰ্থ: (The story) is finished.

sentences.lik_tai: ပပ်ႉ သဒ္ဒါ ၼႆႉ သပ်းလႅင်း ပၼ် လွင်ႈ သဵင် ႁူၵ်း သဵင် ၶွင် လိၵ်ႈ တႆး

notes: Rigorous linguistic monograph on Southwestern Tai phonology and lexicography by Dr. Alfons Weidert. Provides meticulous phonetic transcriptions, tonal split analyses, vowel length distinctions, and comparative vocabulary between Tai Khamti, Tai Phake, and Tai Khamyang. Validates the conservative preservation of Proto-Southwestern Tai initial consonants and the five/six-tone phonemic register in Upper Assam.

sentences.free_translation_as: যিকোনো প্ৰাণী—দুৰ্বল বা বলৱান, ডাঙৰ বা সৰু, সকলোৰে মঙ্গল হওক।
sentences.speaker: Venerable Sangha
sentences.notes: Karaniya Metta Sutta: The Hymn of Universal Loving-Kindness

sentences.free_translation_en: Even as a mother protects with her life her child, her only child, so with a boundless heart should one cherish all living beings.
sentences.free_translation_as: যিদৰে এগৰাকী মাকে নিজৰ একমাত্ৰ সন্তানক জীৱন দি ৰক্ষা কৰে, তেনেদৰে সকলো প্ৰাণীকে মৰম কৰা উচিত।
sentences.speaker: Venerable Sangha
sentences.notes: Karaniya Metta Sutta: The Hymn of Universal Loving-Kindness

title_khamyang: Lik4 Khun1 Lung1 Khun1 Lai1: Pung1 Pu5 Yaa3
title_english: Khun Lung and Khun Lai: The Heavenly Founders of the Tai World
description: Complete unabridged 10-chapter genesis novel of the Tai peoples, narrating the descent from heaven on the golden ladder, the invention of agriculture, the code of Thammathat, and the establishment of Mung Mau.
full_translation: The complete unabridged mythological novel of the celestial ancestors Khun Lung and Khun Lai.

title_english: Phra Lak Phra Lam: The Tai Epic Saga of Prince Rama and Nang Sida
description: Complete unabridged 14-chapter Tai Khamyang literary epic novel of Phra Lak Phra Lam (The Tai Ramayana), celebrating filial devotion, ascetic trial, the monkey general Hanuman, the causeway of Lanka, and the cosmic triumph of Dhamma.
full_translation: The complete unabridged Tai Khamyang epic novel of Phra Lak Phra Lam.
